- **S3K Pachinko bonus-stage trace replay is GREEN: fixed a trace-bootstrap-only registration-order bug that permanently disabled the top-escape exit trigger.** Two compounding gaps in `TraceReplaySessionBootstrap`/`AbstractTraceReplayTest`, both stemming from the trace-replay harness reusing a fixture-built level instead of a fresh `loadZoneAndAct` like production `GameLoop.doEnterBonusStage`: (1) `afterFixtureBuild` (which injects `Obj_PachinkoEnergyTrap`'s bootstrap spawn) ran BEFORE `applyStartPositionAndGroundSnap`'s `LevelManager.initCameraForLevel()`, which unconditionally calls `objectManager.reset(camera.getX())` for S3K's two-axis cursor placement (`LevelManager.java:2564-2577`) -- silently wiping the just-injected trap's dynamic-object slot every time, so it never ran a single `update()`. Swapped the call order so bonus-entry object injection happens after the camera/object-manager reset, matching production's `loadZoneAndAct`-then-`ensureBonusStageBootstrapObjectPresent` sequence (`GameLoop.java:2229`/`2314`). (2) Even with the trap alive, `DefaultObjectServices.bonusStageProvider` is captured as a plain field at construction time; since `ObjectManager`/`DefaultObjectServices` are built during the fixture's generic level load -- before `TraceReplaySessionBootstrap.applyBonusStageEntry` registers the real provider on `GameplayModeContext` -- the captured value stayed pinned to `NoOpBonusStageProvider.INSTANCE` forever, so `services().requestBonusStageExit()` silently no-opped even once the trap could run (production never hits this because `loadZoneAndAct` always builds a fresh `ObjectManager` AFTER the provider is registered). `DefaultObjectServices` now resolves bonus-stage forwarding (`requestExit`/`addRings`/`setAwardedShield`/`bonusStageProviderOrNull`) through its owning `GameplayModeContext`'s CURRENT `activeBonusStageProvider` when one was supplied at construction, falling back to the captured value for the handful of manual (non-session) construction sites. With the trap now live and reachable, `LevelFrameStep` mirrors ROM `LevelLoop`'s `tst.w (Restart_level_flag).w` / `bne.w Level` check (`sonic3k.asm:7895-7896`), which runs immediately after `Process_Sprites` and skips `DeformBgLayer` (camera scroll) for the rest of that frame whenever an object set the flag during that same pass: once `BonusStageProvider.isStageComplete()` becomes true mid-frame (Sonic escaping through the top of the Glowing Spheres board, `PLAYER_ESCAPED_Y=-0x20`), the engine now skips its own camera-scroll/boundary-easing step for that exact frame instead of tracking Sonic's already-updated position one frame early. Together these clear the last Pachinko divergence (frame 2903 `camera_x` off by one pixel), taking `TestS3kPachinkoBonusTraceReplay` from 1 error to 0.
- **S3K Pachinko round bumper bounce is now touch-response-driven instead of a hand-rolled distance check, fixing a spurious double-bounce:** ROM `Obj_Bumper`'s Pachinko branch (`loc_32EF0`/`loc_32EAA`, sonic3k.asm:68877-68880,68906-68908) only re-bounces via `sub_32F34`/`sub_32F56` when `collision_property(a0)` reads set -- a bit populated once per frame by the shared `Add_SpriteToCollisionResponseList`/`Touch_Loop` overlap test, the same ROM-accurate box math every other S3K enemy/object touch already goes through. `PachinkoBumperObjectInstance.checkCollision` instead compared `|player.centreX-spawn.x| < 16` and `|player.centreY-spawn.y| < 8+player.getYRadius()` every `update()`, using the player's full rolling `y_radius` (14) as the box half-height -- wider than the real touch-box overlap the ROM actually gates on. That kept reporting an overlap for a second frame after the player's post-bounce position had already cleared the true touch box, firing a second, unwanted `sub_32F56` bounce off a position the player was already leaving. Converting to `TouchResponseProvider`/`TouchResponseListener` (mirroring the already-correct `CnzBumperObjectInstance` port of the same shared subroutine, including its previously-unported `bclr #Status_RollJump,status(a1)`) and deferring the resolved touch to the object's own `update()` call -- exactly as ROM's per-routine `collision_property` clear/re-test does -- advances the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 2705 to frame 2903 (the last recorded frame; 36 to 1 error, a separate tail-frame camera_x rounding root).
- **S3K Pachinko round bumpers now self-despawn/respawn off the vertical camera band, matching ROM `loc_32EF0`:** `Obj_Bumper`'s Pachinko-zone branch (sonic3k.asm:68836-68841 dispatching to `loc_32EF0`, sonic3k.asm:68905-68919) deletes the bumper sprite and clears its respawn-table bit 7 (`loc_32F22`, sonic3k.asm:68922-68929) whenever `(y_pos & $FF80) - Camera_Y_pos_coarse_back` (unsigned) exceeds `$200`, letting the level's placement table respawn it once the camera returns. `PachinkoBumperObjectInstance` never modeled this; the engine's generic S3K windowing (`ObjectWindowingStrategy.LEGACY`) is X-only and never trips for Pachinko's narrow, camera-relative X range, so bumpers spawned near the top of the (Y-scrolling) board stayed alive for the whole run, eventually exhausting the 89-slot dynamic SST pool and silently dropping a later bumper's one-shot vertical placement window. Implementing the check surfaced a second, orthogonal gap: `ObjectManager.dispatchDestroyRemoveFromActive`'s off-screen respawnable path (`removeFromActiveForUnload`) dropped the spawn from both the X-pass queue and the Y-pass deferred set, so a self-deleted bumper could never be reconsidered unless the X-cursor happened to revisit its index -- unlike ROM's `loc_1B982` Y-camera pass (sonic3k.asm:37728-37773), which rescans every entry still inside the live X-window with a clear respawn bit on every Y-coarse crossing. Re-marking the spawn deferred on that destroy path fixes both together, advancing the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 2704 to frame 2705 (102 to 36 errors).
- **S3K Pachinko flipper drive/launch now applies the ROM board-wall push and ground-speed clear:** `sub_49CFE`'s `loc_49DE4` fall-through (sonic3k.asm:96509-96541), reached from both the idle-ride accel branch (`loc_49D54`->`loc_49D60`) and the launch-trigger branch (`loc_49D68`), continues into `loc_49E28`-`loc_49E56` (sonic3k.asm:96542-96557): `jsr (CheckLeftWallDist).l` then `jsr (CheckRightWallDist).l` (sonic3k.asm:20505, 20188 -- the player-centred `+/-0xA` non-`Obj`-prefixed probes, not `ObjCheckLeftWallDist`/`ObjCheckRightWallDist`), and on a negative (overlapping) distance patches `x_pos(a1)` by that distance and zeroes `ground_vel(a1)` -- without touching `x_vel`/`y_vel` or `Status_Push`. `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.projectGroundVelAndMove` previously stopped after the `MoveSprite_TestGravity2`-equivalent move, on the documented assumption that this particular ride never reaches a board wall; a later ride on the same flipper does. Missing the push left the post-move x position un-corrected and `g_speed` carrying the just-accelerated value instead of being zeroed by the wall response, advancing the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 2085 to frame 2704 (195 to 102 errors).
- **S3K Pachinko flipper catch now writes the ROM's Roll animation id immediately, not just its script restart:** `Obj_PachinkoFlipper`'s newly-locked branch `sub_49CFE` (sonic3k.asm:96416-96434) writes `anim(a1)` as a WORD -- `move.w #2<<8,anim(a1)` at sonic3k.asm:96422, then again as a byte at sonic3k.asm:96428 -- publishing `anim=2` (Roll) into `$1C` and `prev_anim=0` into the adjacent `$1D` unconditionally on every new catch, regardless of whether `Status_Roll` was already set (the `bset #Status_Roll` at sonic3k.asm:96429 only gates the `y_pos+=5` lift that follows, not the anim write). `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.onSolidContact`'s newly-locked branch only called `forceAnimationRestart()`, which resets the tracked `prev_anim` so the next Animate pass restarts the script (fixing the delayed mapping-frame recompute) but never touches `animationId` itself; a player caught mid-air while not already in the engine's Roll animation (having lost it to the shared `applyObjectLandingState`->`clearRollingOnLanding` landing pass earlier in the same frame's checkpoint, which clears rolling and publishes Walk exactly as `Sonic_ResetOnFloor` does) kept `animationId=Walk` for the whole ride instead of Roll. Explicitly writing the resolved Roll animation id alongside `forceAnimationRestart()` advances the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 2084 to frame 2085 (a separate already-locked ground-speed root).
- **S3K Pachinko round bumper no longer resets ground speed and re-bounces only once per touch:** `PachinkoBumperObjectInstance.applyBounce` cleared `g_speed` to 0 on every bounce and gated re-application behind an invented 8-frame cooldown, but ROM `sub_32F34`/`sub_32F56` (sonic3k.asm:68934-68968) never write `ground_vel(a1)` and have no cooldown timer -- they simply clear `collision_property` and re-bounce every frame it reads set (the same per-frame poll model as the general S3K ENEMY-touch collision-response list). The bounce also biased its launch angle by the raw per-object `update()` `frameCounter` parameter (`ObjectManager`'s internal `vblaCounter`) `& 3`, but ROM's `move.b (Level_frame_counter).w,d1` (no `+1` offset) reads the HIGH byte of the big-endian `Level_frame_counter` word, i.e. `(Level_frame_counter >> 8) & 3` of the ROM-aligned counter (mirroring the existing S2 `BumperObjectInstance` port of the identical CNZ-bumper idiom). Since the player's hitbox typically stays inside the bumper's collision box for 2+ consecutive frames after a bounce, the cooldown was suppressing a real second ROM re-bounce (using that frame's already-updated player position) and freezing velocity at the first bounce's value. Together these fixes advance the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 1318 to frame 2084 (391 to 39 errors).
- Fix(s3k): S3K Pachinko item orb now reads its reward-table index from the HIGH byte of `y_pos` and stays armed until the player truly releases. ROM `Obj_PachinkoItemOrb` `loc_4A238`/`loc_4A3B6` (sonic3k.asm:96795-96802, 96921-96924) select the reward subtype and ring amount with `move.b y_pos(a0),dN` -- a big-endian byte read of the MSB, i.e. `(y_pos >> 8) & $F` (bits 8-11 of the pixel Y) -- not the low nibble of the full position; `PachinkoItemOrbObjectInstance.resolveRewardSubtype`/`GumballItemObjectInstance.onCollectPachinkoRingReward` were masking `y & $F`, collapsing the table base to a wrong 0-15 band. Separately, the orb's `$D7`->`$C0` (`Touch_Special`/`collision_property` notify) collision class re-registers on the collision-response list every frame so the player's `Touch_Loop` sets `collision_property` on every overlapping pass; the engine profile was edge-triggered (`continuousCallbacks=false`), so the armed->convert state machine saw "release" one frame after the first touch and rolled the subtype against the wrong `Level_frame_counter` phase. Marking the profile `continuousCallbacks=true` lets the orb detect the true release frame, at which its existing `ObjectManager.getFrameCounter()` read already matches the ROM `Level_frame_counter` (verified against trace ground truth: the y=`$08B0` orb, `Level_frame_counter&3=3`, resolves to subtype 7 / bubble shield and spawns `Obj_BubbleShield` at frame 1149). Together these clear the spurious +30-ring award and advance the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 1148 to frame 1318 (a downstream bounce/flipper physics root).
- Fix(s3k): S3K complete-run recorder (v6.32-s3k-completerun) now captures the ROM `V_int_run_count` free-running VBlank counter (sonic3k.constants.asm:790, `CrossResetRAM+$0C`) once at bonus-segment arm time and emits it as decimal `metadata.v_int_run_count` for gumball/pachinko/slots segments (zone ids `0x13`-`0x15`). `TraceReplaySessionBootstrap.applyBonusStageEntry` primes `S3kSlotBonusStageRuntime` from this value when present, so `Slots_CycleOptions` (sonic3k.asm:99614-99946) reads a recorded-run-derived counter (`recordedBase + ticks-since-entry`) instead of the per-session `ObjectManager.vblaCounter` approximation. Re-captured `s3-knux-multibonus-ss` (physics.csv rows byte-identical; only metadata gained the field) and updated the committed slots/gumball/pachinko fixtures. `TestS3kSlotsBonusTraceReplay`'s originally-cited frame-269/271 rings divergence (expected=75, actual=76) is now fixed and the frontier moves to frame 301, where a further, likely-independent multi-reel-cycle divergence remains open (see `docs/S3K_KNOWN_DISCREPANCIES.md`, "Gumball Machine Frame-0 RNG Reseed", Slots subsection). Gumball/Pachinko trace error counts are unchanged (74/391); `metadata.v_int_run_count` is a no-op for those profiles.
- Fix(s3k): Gumball bonus stage machine spin animation now advances through its ROM per-value sequence (`6,7,$14,5`, each held 4 calls, plus 1 control-detect call = 17 total) instead of holding the wrong values (`5,6,7,$14,5` at 4,4,4,4,1) for the same 17-frame total; `Animate_RawNoSST`'s `anim_frame_timer` starts at 0 on SPIN entry so the first advance immediately skips the entry frame (`byte_61450[0]=5`) rather than displaying it (sonic3k.asm:177341). Render-only (`currentFrame` only feeds `drawFrameIndex`); does not change any trace-compared field. Also corrected a stale `TraceReplaySessionBootstrap` comment still describing the machine's now-removed frame-0 RNG reseed as active code, and added focused unit tests locking in the Gumball item's half-open proximity box, dock-eligibility threshold, and un-latched push re-poll boundaries.
- Fix(s3k): Gumball bonus stage machine container animation now lasts the ROM-accurate 29 frames per dispense cycle, not 32. `GumballMachineObjectInstance.ContainerDisplayChild` iterated all five `byte_6145B` (frame,delay) pairs (4+4+16+4+4 = 32 frames), but ROM `Animate_RawNoSSTMultiDelay` (sonic3k.asm) advances `anim_frame` by 2 on each timer expiry and its `$F4` handler `loc_845CC` does `clr.b anim_frame`, so every run restarts at offset 0 with a stale-negative timer and the first animating frame advances immediately past the leading `(2,$3)` pair — the run shows frames 3,4,3,2 and clears machine bit 1 exactly 29 frames after the ball spawns (verified against the recorded trace: container ANIM state spans f139-f167, f189-f217, f627-f656, f675-f704 = 29 frames every cycle). The extra 3 frames per cycle drifted the dispense cadence enough that the machine skipped the f675 re-dispense, so the subtype-4 push ball that should sit at y=0x1B9 in the player's ±0x18 box at f728 was absent and the player was never launched. Emulating the animate routine faithfully advances the Gumball bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 728 to frame 895 (the f728-817 push region now matches).
- Fix(s3k): Gumball bonus stage machine-ejected subtype-4 "push" balls can push the player more than once. `GumballItemObjectInstance` latched a `pushedPlayer` flag to permanently stop polling `Check_PlayerInRange` after the first push, citing ROM's `clr.b collision_property(a0)` (loc_6116E) as the source of a re-trigger gate; that instruction only clears the STANDARD touch-response-list latch (`Add_SpriteToCollisionResponseList`/`Touch_Loop`, sonic3k.asm:96850), which the self-polled `GUMBALL_EJECT` path never consults (`getCollisionFlags()` returns 0 while ejected). ROM's `loc_60EFC`/`sub_610E0` (sonic3k.asm:127786-127809,127849-127868) calls `Check_PlayerInRange` unconditionally on every dock-eligible frame with no persistent gate, so a still-alive push ball (subtype 4 sets `d2=0`, never deleted) that drifts back within the ±0x18 box on a later frame pushes again in ROM. Removing the latch from the self-poll path reduces the Gumball bonus-stage trace comparator from 64 to 54 errors (frontier still frame 728, a distinct upstream root).
- Fix(s3k): Gumball bonus stage machine-ejected ball is dispensed on the ROM-accurate frame and its subtype-4 push imparts the correct `GetArcTan` bump velocity. Three ROM-faithful corrections to one divergence: (1) the machine's `Check_PlayerInRange` activation box is now tested HALF-OPEN — low edges inclusive, high edges exclusive — matching `sub_8592C`'s `bhs` rejections (`sonic3k.asm:179994-180031`), so a player rising flush onto the bottom edge (`py == objY+8`) no longer triggers the spin a frame early; (2) the machine spin lasts 17 frames, not 20 — ROM `Animate_RawNoSST` (`sonic3k.asm:177341`) starts `anim_frame_timer` at 0, so the first spin frame advances immediately (1 game-frame) before the remaining four hold for 4 each, reaching the `$F4` control byte / bit-3 dispense at `1+4*4` (`loc_60D1E`/`loc_60D32`; IDLE->SPIN frame 122, ball dispensed frame 139); together these place the falling ball at its ROM y (`0x2B1`, not `0x2AD`) when the player reaches it. (3) `sub_61176`'s angle jitter (`sonic3k.asm:127878-127880`) reads the HIGH byte of the big-endian `Level_frame_counter` word via `move.b (addr).w`, i.e. `(Level_frame_counter >> 8) & 3`, not the low bits of `ObjectManager`'s since-load counter — mirroring the S2 `BumperObjectInstance`/`CrawlBadnikInstance` handling of the same idiom. With the ball at its correct position (`dy=22`, `GetArcTan(14,22)=41`) and the jitter `(380>>8)&3=1`, the push angle resolves to 42, giving the exact ROM push velocity (`-0x395,-0x5FD`); advances the Gumball bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 380 to frame 728 (90 to 64 errors).
- Fix(s3k): Gumball bonus stage machine-ejected balls now self-poll a ROM-accurate `Check_PlayerInRange` proximity box (±0x18/24px, half-open, sonic3k.asm:127786-127809,179994-180031) instead of registering with the generic small touch-collision framework, and clamp to their spawning container's live y each frame while gated to reward-eligible only $10 (16px) below it (`loc_60EE0`/`loc_60EFC`, sonic3k.asm:127609-127624). The prior 8x8-ish generic touch box fired the subtype-4 push reward against the wrong item position, feeding a wrong `GetArcTan` angle into the push velocity; advances the Gumball bonus-stage trace frontier past frame 380 (121 to 90 errors).
- Fix(s3k): Gumball bonus stage no longer clobbers the run-history RNG seed with a per-session counter. ROM `Obj_GumballMachine` reseeds `RNG_seed` from `V_int_run_count` at init (sonic3k.asm:127412) to fold run-history entropy into the ball-subtype roll (`sub_612A8`, sonic3k.asm:127988-128008). `GumballMachineObjectInstance` re-derived that from its `update` `frameCounter` argument (`ObjectManager.vblaCounter`, a per-gameplay-session counter, not `V_int_run_count`), overwriting the RNG's already run-dependent seed with a wrong value and flipping a ball to the rings subtype the recorded run never dispensed (+10 rings ~445 frames early). The shared RNG already holds run-history entropy on this tick (run-advanced in live play; bootstrap-primed to the recorded `V_int_run_count` in replay, uniformly for every trace with `metadata.rng_seed`), so the reseed is a no-op read of that value; removing the erroneous `setSeed` uniformly (no trace gating, no simulation-time trace read) advances the Gumball bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 348 to frame 380.
- **S3K Slots bonus stage `vblaCounter`-as-`V_int_run_count` gap now correctly documented, not overclaimed:** `S3kSlotBonusStageRuntime.globalVIntRunCounter()`'s javadoc previously cited `GumballMachineObjectInstance`'s "matching seed comment" as if it endorsed `ObjectManager.vblaCounter` as a validated match for ROM `V_int_run_count`; that comment (and the "Gumball Machine Frame-0 RNG Reseed" entry in `docs/S3K_KNOWN_DISCREPANCIES.md`) actually documents `vblaCounter` as a *disclosed-inaccurate* approximation -- a per-gameplay-session counter that resets far more often, and starts from a materially smaller range, than the true hardware counter. Softened the javadoc to stop implying an accuracy endorsement the cited source explicitly disclaims, and extended the discrepancies doc's Impact section to state that Slots' reel-word seed, per-reel velocity offsets, fixed-row scan seed, random-target draw, and countdown extension inherit this same approximation gap (previously the doc said "no other Gumball, Pachinko, or Slots behavior is affected," which this round's `54bf6b099`/`683c84993` changes made stale). No behavior change; also added focused unit test coverage for the reel-B rotate fix and the `checkRingPickup`/`dispatchTileInteraction` ground-projected-position + object-control gate added this round, none of which previously had test coverage of their own.
- **S3K Slots bonus stage option-cycle reel-B spin velocity is no longer a frame-invariant constant:** `S3kSlotOptionCycleSystem.tickPickTargets` computed the reel-1 (middle reel) velocity offset with `java.lang.Integer.rotateLeft(frameCounter & 0xFF, 4)`, a 32-bit rotate; ROM's `loc_4C480` (sonic3k.asm:99684-99686) uses `rol.b #4,d0`, an 8-bit rotate of the same `V_int_run_count` low byte. Since the masked operand only ever populates bits 0-7, `Integer.rotateLeft` never wraps a set bit back into the low 3 bits `andi.b #7,d0` then reads, so the computed offset was always `0x2C` regardless of the seed. Replaced with the class's existing `rotateRight8` helper (equivalent to an 8-bit `rol.b #4` since a 4-bit rotate is its own inverse on a byte), restoring the frame-dependent reel-B decelerate/lock-in speed. Verified against `TestS3kSlotsBonusTraceReplay` (still frame 271 / 179 errors -- this trace's specific reel-lock outcome does not happen to be sensitive to reel-B's approach speed, so the fix does not move that frontier) and the existing slots unit tests (unaffected).
- **S3K Slots bonus stage option-cycle reel spin no longer seeds itself from the level-local frame counter:** `S3kSlotOptionCycleSystem`'s reel-word init, per-reel velocity offsets, fixed-row scan seed, random-target draw, and post-decelerate countdown extension all read ROM's `V_int_run_count` (a longword that counts every VBlank since power-on and never resets on level load -- `sonic3k.asm:99646,99679-99702,99722,99753-99755`), but `S3kSlotBonusStageRuntime.update` was feeding them the bonus stage's own level-local frame counter (reset to whatever `LevelManager.getFrameCounter()` held when the stage loaded) instead. That fed the wrong seed into reel-target selection, resolving a different prize than ROM and producing a rings-count divergence well before any position/velocity field diverges. Routing the option-cycle tick through `ObjectManager.getVblaCounter()` -- this engine's persistent, never-reset-on-level-load run counter, the same `V_int_run_count` approximation every ordinary object's `update(int frameCounter, ...)` dispatch already receives -- advances the Slots bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 269 to frame 271 (213 to 179 errors); the remaining reel-target mismatch traces to this specific trace fixture's schema-v6 `vblank_counter` column recording a static adjacent RAM word instead of the true running count (see `TraceData.initialVblankCounter`'s existing `usesBk2VblankCounterFallback` doc comment), a pre-existing capture-format gap, not a live-play bug.
- **S3K Slots bonus stage ring/tile checks no longer read the player's fully-stepped position:** `S3kSlotBonusStageRuntime.checkRingPickup`/`dispatchTileInteraction` read the player's origin *after* the frame's air-velocity `MoveSprite2` step, but ROM's `sub_4BDCA` (ring pickup) and `sub_4BE3A` (tile dispatch, bumper-launch branch) read `x_pos(a0)`/`y_pos(a0)` right after `sub_4BABC`'s ground-velocity projection and *before* `sub_4BCB0`'s air gravity is folded into position by `MoveSprite2` (sonic3k.asm:98776-98780, 99224-99225). `S3kSlotPlayerRuntime` now exposes that intermediate `groundProjectedOriginX/Y` snapshot for both checks to consume. Also gated `checkRingPickup` on `!player.isObjectControlled()`, matching ROM's `loc_4BA62` (sonic3k.asm:98751-98752) early return that skips the whole ground/air/ring/tile chain while the player is held by the bonus cage grab -- the ring probe was previously running unconditionally and could award a ring for whichever grid cell the grabbed player happened to be parked over.
- **S3K Pachinko item orb now waits for touch release before converting, and resolves its reward subtype from the ROM-aligned frame counter:** `Obj_PachinkoItemOrb`'s `loc_4A238` (sonic3k.asm:96789-96804) re-checks `collision_property` every pass and only proceeds to `REWARD_TABLE`/`byte_1E4484` selection once it reads clear (`loc_4A274`, sonic3k.asm:96807-96811) -- a touch that never releases never converts. `PachinkoItemOrbObjectInstance` converted on the very next `update()` after any single touch with no release check, and sampled the reward-table `Level_frame_counter` phase from its own `update()` parameter, which is `ObjectManager`'s internal `vblaCounter` (a session-relative counter carrying a large, non-multiple-of-4 bootstrap offset from the ROM-aligned counter), corrupting the `&3` phase used by the subtype lookup. The orb now models the arm/wait-for-release state split and reads `services().objectManager().getFrameCounter()` (the same ROM-aligned counter `CnzBumperObjectInstance`/`AizFallingLogObjectInstance` already rely on) for the reward-subtype phase instead of the raw `vblaCounter` parameter.
- **S3K Pachinko magnet orb no longer blocks ring pickups while the player orbits it:** `Obj_PachinkoMagnetOrb`'s catch routine `sub_4A428` (sonic3k.asm:97091) sets `object_control(a1)` to plain `1` -- bit 0 only, the "movement suppressed" gate -- never bit 7. The `Sonic_Control` dispatcher's own TouchResponse gate (sonic3k.asm:22019-22022: `move.b object_control(a0),d0 / andi.b #$A0,d0 / bne.s locret_10C8E / jsr (TouchResponse).l`) only skips `TouchResponse` (which runs both `Test_Ring_Collisions`/`GiveRing` and the general `Touch_Loop`) when bits 5 or 7 (`$A0`) are set, so ring pickups keep working every frame the player is captured by the orb. `PachinkoMagnetOrbObjectInstance.capturePlayer` instead applied `ObjectControlState.nativeBit7FullControl()`, which also suppresses touch response, so any ring the player passed while orbiting was silently skipped -- a permanent ring-count desync starting at the first ring touched mid-orbit. Switching to `ObjectControlState.nativeBits0To6CpuAllowedMovementSuppressed()` (bit 0 only, touch/CPU still allowed) matches the ROM value and clears the frame-1252 ring-count divergence in the Pachinko bonus-stage trace.
- **S3K Pachinko flipper launch now measures distance from the trigger-frame's already-moved position and no longer overwrites the launch facing:** ROM `loc_49D68`'s `bra.w loc_49DE4` (sonic3k.asm:96460-96462) falls all the way through `loc_49E0A` (sonic3k.asm:96532-96541), projecting the just-decelerated `ground_vel` onto the player's angle and running `MoveSprite_TestGravity2` -- moving `x_pos`/`y_pos` -- *before* the top-level `Obj_PachinkoFlipper` routine consumes the queued trigger and calls `sub_49D72` (sonic3k.asm:96469-96504), which measures `x_pos(a1)-x_pos(a0)` for its sine/cosine launch-velocity formula. `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.launchPlayer` only applied the ground_vel decel and skipped that projection/move step, so the distance formula read the pre-trigger position (2px short at `ground_vel=0x200`/`angle=0`), producing the wrong launch angle/magnitude for the whole subsequent flight. Separately, `launchPlayer` derived the launched player's facing from the computed velocity's sign, but `sub_49D72`'s `bset`/`bclr` pair (sonic3k.asm:96498-96499) only ever touches `Status_InAir`/`Status_OnObj` -- it never writes `Status_Facing`, so the launch keeps whatever facing the player had while locked even when the velocity points the opposite way. Adding the missing projection/move step and dropping the facing write advance the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 454 to frame 1252 (945 to 392 errors).
- **S3K Pachinko flipper catch now restarts the locked player's roll animation, matching ROM `prev_anim=0`:** `Obj_PachinkoFlipper`'s newly-locked branch writes `anim(a1)` as a WORD -- `move.w #2<<8,anim(a1)` (sonic3k.asm:96422) -- storing `anim=2` (Roll) into `$1C` and `prev_anim=0` into the adjacent `$1D`. Because `prev_anim` now mismatches `anim`, the next `Animate_Knuckles` pass resets `anim_frame=0`/`anim_frame_timer=0` (sonic3k.asm:33034-33037), so the ball's roll spin restarts from the first `AniKnuckles02` frame the frame after the catch. The engine's `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.lockPlayer` set roll radii/`Status_Roll` but never invalidated the tracked `prev_anim`, so the roll animation kept advancing from its airborne index and stayed one rotation-cycle step (two `AniKnuckles02` entries) ahead of the ROM for the whole flipper ride; `player_mapping_frame` was the dominant divergence. `onSolidContact`'s newly-locked branch now calls `forceAnimationRestart()` (invalidating the tracked `prev_anim` so the next Animate restarts the script, matching the one-frame-delayed ROM reset), clearing every `player_mapping_frame` divergence through the ride and advancing the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 435 to frame 454 (a separate launch-velocity root).
- **S3K Pachinko flipper launch no longer discards the player's residual ground speed:** `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.launchPlayer` set `g_speed` to 0, but ROM `sub_49D72` (sonic3k.lst:96469-96504) never touches `ground_vel(a1)` when it writes the launch `x_vel`/`y_vel` -- `ground_vel` is left at whatever the last `loc_49D54` accel step produced. Separately, the launch-trigger frame itself still runs `loc_49D68`->`loc_49DE4` (sonic3k.lst:96460-96524) before the top-level routine consumes the queued trigger and calls `sub_49D72`, so `ground_vel` gets one more nudge-toward-zero step by `d5` (the `Ctrl_x_logical` action-button mask) that the engine's `launchPlayer`-only path skipped entirely. `launchPlayer` now leaves `g_speed` untouched and applies that trigger-frame decel using the engine's collapsed `INPUT_JUMP` bit (0x10, matching ROM's `button_B_mask`) as the best available stand-in for `d5`, advancing the Pachinko bonus-stage trace error count from 956 to 841 (frontier remains frame 435, a separate non-cascading roll-animation-tick stutter).
- **S3K Pachinko flipper now owns the locked player's per-frame move instead of letting the player's own roll physics run a frame behind:** while locked, ROM `object_control` bit 0 makes the player skip `Sonic_Modes` entirely (sonic3k.asm:21973-21976), so the flipper's `loc_49DE4` (sonic3k.asm:96509-96534) applies acceleration to `ground_vel`, projects x_vel/y_vel from the **post-accel** `ground_vel`, moves, and runs its own wall check (which never sets `Status_Push`). The engine instead kept running the player's roll update under `pinballSpeedLock`, projecting x_vel from the **pre-accel** `ground_vel` and then running the `loc_11350` ground-wall check; that one-frame projection lag made the wall sensor predict 1px into a flipper-side wall, wrongly zeroing `g_speed`, mangling `x_vel` to `+0xE8`, and setting `Status_Push` (trace f431 expected g_speed/x_speed=0x0000, status=0x0D; engine produced g_speed=0x0018, x_speed=0x00E8, status=0x2D). `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.lockPlayer` now asserts the ROM object_control bit-0 movement gate (`ObjectControlState.MOVEMENT_SUPPRESSED_ONLY`, which leaves TouchResponse/SolidObject riding active) and `driveLockedPlayer` performs the `loc_49D54`+`loc_49DE4` accelerate/project/move, advancing the Pachinko bonus-stage physics trace frontier from frame 431 to frame 454.
- **S3K Pachinko flipper no longer corrupts ground speed and facing while locked to a player:** `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.lockPlayer` only set `controlLocked` (which blocks input reads) without suppressing the player's own per-frame roll update, so `PlayableSpriteMovement`'s friction/deceleration/stop-rolling block kept running every locked frame; because ROM `object_control` bit 0 makes the player's control routine skip `Sonic_Modes` (and therefore `Sonic_RollSpeed`) entirely while locked (sonic3k.asm:21973-21976), and the flipper's own `sub_49CFE`/`loc_49D54` (sonic3k.asm:96416-96457) only ever adds the surface accel to `ground_vel`, the engine's still-running roll-stop check saw `g_speed` cross below `min_roll_speed` and slammed it to the pinball-mode `+-0x400` snap on the frame after locking. Asserting the existing `pinballSpeedLock` flag (the engine's `spin_dash_flag`-0x81 stand-in already used by `AutoSpinObjectInstance`) while locked drops just the friction/deceleration/stop-rolling block, matching the net effect of ROM's full-routine bypass. Separately, `applySurfaceAcceleration` unconditionally called `setDirection()`, but ROM's `loc_49D54` never writes `status(a1)`/facing -- removing that spurious write stops the accel step from clobbering the landing facing bit. Together these advance the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier past frame 431 (518 to 374 errors).
- **S3K Pachinko flipper no longer double-counts surface acceleration on the frame it locks the player:** `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance.onSolidContact` called `applySurfaceAcceleration` on every locked frame including the very first (`newlyLocked`) one, but ROM `sub_49CFE` (sonic3k.asm:96416-96434) returns via `locret_49D3A` immediately after locking control/radii/`Status_Roll` on a new lock, never touching `ground_vel(a1)`; acceleration (`loc_49D54`, sonic3k.asm:96449-96457) is only reachable through the already-locked branch (`loc_49D3C`, taken when the per-player lock byte was already nonzero). Applying it on the lock frame too added `+0x18` on top of the landing's `ground_vel=x_vel` carry-over, advancing the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 430 to frame 431.
- **S3K Pachinko flipper no longer subtracts a spurious 4px slope baseline from its landing surface:** `PachinkoFlipperObjectInstance` inherited the default `getSlopeBaseline()` (subtracting `slopeData[0]`, `-4` for this table), but ROM `SolidObjCheckSloped2` (sonic3k.asm:42076-42097), reached via `SolidObjectTopSloped2` from `Obj_PachinkoFlipper`'s `loc_49C8A` (sonic3k.asm:96384), samples the slope table byte and subtracts it from `y_pos(a0)` directly with no baseline term. The spurious offset raised the flipper's effective collision surface, causing a false-positive landing roughly one frame before the ROM player actually reached it (mid-arc over the flipper, still airborne). Overriding `getSlopeBaseline()` to return 0 (matching the established Seesaw/collapsing-platform pattern) advances the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 427 to frame 430 (896 to 243 errors).
- Fix(s3k): blue ball special stage bumper different-cell unlock no longer applies the newly-reversed velocity to position on its own frame, and the chaos/super emerald art-load wait now models the ROM's `Kos_modules_left` gate with a measured frame count instead of resetting `clear_timer` instantly, closing the `TestS3kSpecialStageTraceReplay` frontier to 0 errors (sonic3k.asm:12007-12039,12613-12620).
- Fix(s3k): blue ball special stage entry now holds the object's per-frame routine for 22 real frames after the boot's pre-call before resuming, matching the ROM's `Pal_FadeFromWhite` fade-in hold, so `Special_stage_rate`/`rate_timer` no longer advance early and desync the speed cap and downstream position/velocity later in the run (sonic3k.asm:10717,10735,10741-10744,5139-5150).
- Fix(s3k): blue ball special stage collision-response queue entries (blue sphere/ring) fire their first animation step on the creation frame instead of a full timer cycle later (sonic3k.asm:12742-12753, 10744-10746).
- Fix(s3k): blue ball special stage turn-completion falls through to position/collision update on the same frame instead of deferring to the next frame (sonic3k.asm:11946-11955).
- **S1 special stage emerald pickup now correctly arms the exit via its sparkle animation, not a GOAL touch:** the prior fix (below) stopped the exit routine from firing synchronously on emerald pickup, but the ROM does not actually gate the special-stage exit on the GOAL block ($27) at all -- `SS_AniEmeraldSparks` (the same collection-animation queue the ring sparkle uses) writes `move.b #4,(v_player+obRoutine).w` itself once its 4-frame sparkle script finishes, ~24-25 ticks after the emerald is touched. `checkItems()`'s emerald branch now registers that animation (mirroring the ring/bumper/glass registrations already in `Sonic1SpecialStageManager`) instead of clearing the block immediately, and the animation's terminator sets `exitTriggered` and plays the GOAL jingle. This closes the S1 GHZ maze round-trip trace, which ends the special stage via a single collected emerald and never touches a GOAL block (`docs/s1disasm/_inc/Special Stage Loading & Drawing.asm:437-458`, `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/09 Sonic in Special Stage.asm:669-701`).
- **S1 special stage emerald pickup no longer ends the maze early:** `checkItems()`'s emerald branch ($3B-$40) was setting `exitTriggered`/`exitPhase`/`exitTimer`, freezing Sonic's position into the exit-stage spin-up the tick after grabbing an emerald; the ROM's `SonicSS_ChkEmerald`/`SonicSS_GetEmerald` only increments `(v_emeralds).w` and queues the emerald jingle -- the special-stage exit routine is armed exclusively by `SonicSS_ChkGOAL`'s `addq.b #2,obRoutine(a0)` when the GOAL block ($27) is touched. The bogus early exit desynced the S1 maze round-trip capture for the rest of the run once an emerald was collected mid-maze (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/09 Sonic in Special Stage.asm:670-701,823-832`).
- **S1 special stage bumpers now flash through their $32/$33 recovery frames instead of staying re-triggerable:** `Obj09_ChkBumper` registers the `SS_AniBumper` animation on the touched block, so a bumper Sonic just bounced off reads as a non-`$25` id (still solid, but not the bumper id) until the script's terminator explicitly restores `id_SS_Bumper`; without this, revisiting the same bumper mid-flash wrongly fired a second bounce instead of behaving like an inert wall (`docs/s1disasm/_inc/Special Stage Loading & Drawing.asm:356-382`, `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/09 Sonic in Special Stage.asm:810-816`).
- **S1 special stage's fall-probe collision scan no longer stops at the first solid cell:** `SonicSS_FindWall` (sub_1BCE8) unconditionally visits all four 2x2 cells and lets the LAST solid hit overwrite `sonss_touchedblock_id`, so a wall block found before an adjacent bumper still surfaces the bumper's bounce reaction on the same tick; the engine's early-return scan previously kept the wall's id instead, leaving Sonic clamped to the wall's stop-velocity response and starving `Obj09_ChkItems2`'s bumper branch (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/09 Sonic in Special Stage.asm:520-583`).
- **S1 special stage: `PalCycle_SS` fires once during GM_Special's instant setup (not just per-frame in `SS_MainLoop`), and `SonicSS_Jump`/`SonicSS_AngleSpeed`'s angle transforms now mask/add before negating (byte-truncation order), matching the ROM's `neg.b` semantics:** the missing setup-time palette-cycle advance left `v_ssbganim` one table entry behind for the rest of the stage, and the reordered angle negation corrupted jump/ground-movement `vel_x`/`vel_y` whenever the stage-rotation angle's top byte wasn't already a multiple of 4 (`docs/s1disasm/sonic.asm:3266`, `docs/s1disasm/_inc/Special Stage Background & Palette Cycle.asm:79-135`, `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/09 Sonic in Special Stage.asm:178-181,299-302`).
- **S1 special stage defers `v_ssangle`/`v_ssrotate` init to GM_Special's actual instant-setup point:** the 44-tick pre-physics hold previously applied `SS_INIT_ROTATION` from `Sonic1SpecialStageManager.initialize()` (tick 0), but the ROM only writes `v_ssangle`/`v_ssrotate` from GM_Special's instant setup block, which runs after the `PaletteWhiteOut` fade's 22 VBlank ticks, not before it; the hold now applies those fields exactly at that mid-hold boundary (`docs/s1disasm/sonic.asm:3238-3291,3267-3268`, `docs/s1disasm/_inc/Palette Fading.asm:313-326`).
- **S1 special stage now models the ROM's 44-VBlank-tick pre-physics hold before Obj09's first `ExecuteObjects` tick:** `GM_Special` never calls `ExecuteObjects` during `PaletteWhiteOut`/instant-setup/`PaletteWhiteIn`, so Sonic1SpecialStageManager freezes all Obj09-owned fields (and defers the in-air flag Obj09_Main sets on its own first tick) for that window; `SpecialStageStartupPolicy.FAST` callers fast-forward through it via `advanceToEntryPresentation()` while `TRACE_ACCURATE` observes it frame-by-frame (`docs/s1disasm/sonic.asm:3221-3308`, `docs/s1disasm/_inc/Palette Fading.asm:212-236,313-326`, `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/09 Sonic in Special Stage.asm:41-53`).
- **Reverted: S3K Gumball bonus stage RNG-seed trace suppression violated the comparison-only invariant.** A prior change had `TraceReplaySessionBootstrap` suppress `GumballMachineObjectInstance`'s own ROM-modeled frame-0 RNG reseed during trace replay so a trace-injected seed would survive unclobbered, instead of computing the correct value. That let engine state (the RNG seed) be hydrated from trace data and left live, non-replay play with the same acknowledged-wrong local counter approximation forever. Reverted `suppressInitialRngReseed`/`suppressGumballInitialRngReseedIfApplicable`; the frame-0 RNG divergence between the engine's session-local `ObjectManager.vblaCounter` and hardware `V_int_run_count` is now an honestly documented gap (see `docs/S3K_KNOWN_DISCREPANCIES.md`) instead of a trace-gated workaround.
- **S3K Gumball bonus stage triangle bumpers now register an exact edge-flush bounce on time:** `GumballTriangleBumperObjectInstance` used the engine's default exclusive-right-edge solid contact boundary, but ROM `SolidObjectFull_1P`'s new-contact path falls through `loc_1DF88` into the shared `SolidObject_cont` X-overlap test (`sonic3k.asm:41395-41406`), which rejects only when `d0 > d3` (`bhi`) -- an exact edge touch (`d0 == d3`) still counts as contact. Overriding `usesInclusiveRightEdge()` to match `SolidObjectFull`'s call site (`sonic3k.asm:127651`) fixes the case where the player's approach lines up flush with the bumper's half-width, advancing the Gumball bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 112 to frame 348 (130 to 54 errors).
- **S3K Pachinko magnet orb release no longer shifts the player 5px down when entering the roll box:** `PachinkoMagnetOrbObjectInstance.releasePlayer` did a feet-planted roll entry (`setY(getY() + getRollHeightAdjustment())`, the full height diff), which shifts the reported centre down 5px. ROM `loc_4A4F6` (sonic3k.asm:97029-97042) asserts `y_radius=$E`/`x_radius=7`/`Status_Roll` as direct writes with NO `y_pos` modification -- unlike `Sonic_Roll`'s feet-planted `addq.w #5,y_pos`, the magnet-orb release keeps the centre (y_pos) fixed while the collision box shrinks to ball size. Restoring the pre-roll centre after the box shrink advances the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 94 (y 0x0EBF vs ROM 0x0EBA).
- **S3K Pachinko magnet orb orbit no longer negates the X offset after shifting instead of before:** `PachinkoMagnetOrbObjectInstance.placePlayerOnOrbit` computed `spawn.x() - ((radius*sin(angleB))>>8)`, but ROM `sub_4A5E0` (sonic3k.asm:97103-97119) computes the X term as `moveq #0,d2 / sub.l d5,d2 / asr.l #8,d2` -- it negates the full-precision `radius*sin(angleB)` product *before* the arithmetic shift, not after. Because 68000 `asr.l` floors toward negative infinity, `asr(-P,8)` differs from `-(asr(P,8))` by exactly 1 (0x0100 in 8.8 velocity units) whenever the product isn't a multiple of 256. Negating first (matching ROM) advances the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 55 to frame 94 (580 to 289 errors).
- **S3K Slots bonus stage cage capture no longer zeroes the player's subpixel fraction:** `S3kSlotBonusCageObjectInstance.updateCapture` used `setCentreX`/`setCentreY`, but ROM `loc_4C026` (sonic3k.asm:99395-99396) writes the capture position with a word-sized `move.w #$460,x_pos(a1)` / `move.w #$430,y_pos(a1)`, which only overwrites the pixel half of the 32-bit position and leaves the subpixel fraction from that same frame's own ground/air movement untouched; `updateSpawnRewards` also re-stomped that fraction to zero on every subsequent hold-state frame with the same non-ROM setters, even though ROM's hold state (`loc_4C0AA`/`loc_4C172`, sonic3k.asm:99416-99509) never touches the captured player's position again. Switching both to `setCentreXPreserveSubpixel`/`setCentreYPreserveSubpixel` and dropping the redundant hold-state re-snap advances the Slots bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 47 to frame 269.
- **S3K Pachinko magnet orb no longer flips the sign of the captured player's velocity:** `PachinkoMagnetOrbObjectInstance.updateCapturedPlayer` derived `x_speed`/`y_speed` from this frame's orbit displacement with an extra unary negation, but ROM `sub_4A428` loc_4A464 (sonic3k.asm:96974-96989) computes `neg.w` on `(old-new)<<8`, which is algebraically `(new-old)<<8` -- plain per-frame displacement, not its negation. Removing the extra negation advances the Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 46 to frame 55.
- **S3K Slots bonus stage no longer clamps ground-speed reversal to zero:** `S3kSlotPlayerRuntime.applyMoveWithCollision` clamped a reversing player's `ground_vel` at 0 whenever the `$40` reversal decel would overshoot past zero, but ROM's `sub_4BB54`/`sub_4BB84` (sonic3k.asm:98854-98909) store the `subi.w #$40,d0`/`addi.w #$40,d0` result unconditionally -- the trailing `bcc.s`/`nop` is dead code, so a single frame of reversal decel can flip `ground_vel` straight through zero into the opposite sign. Removing the clamp advances the Slots bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 28 to frame 47 (220 to 207 errors).
- **S3K Gumball bonus stage triangle bumpers no longer bounce the player from a non-ROM proximity check:** a legacy "fallback" heuristic ran every frame with a symmetric bounding box (the bumper's `SolidObjectFull` half-extents plus the player's full half-width/half-height on every side), firing a bounce whenever the player was merely nearby and airborne instead of ROM's actual asymmetric `SolidObjectFull` contact. Removing it and relying solely on the generic `SolidObjectProvider`/`SolidObjectListener` pass advances the Gumball bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 27 to frame 112, matching ROM's own bounce-response frame (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:127639-127706`).
- **S3K Slots bonus stage no longer fabricates a player rotation angle from the slot machine's spin accumulator:** `S3kSlotPlayerRuntime` wrote `player.angle` from `Stat_table` every frame, but `Obj_Sonic_RotatingSlotBonus` and its subroutines (ground velocity, air gravity, collision, goal-exit fade) never reference `angle(a0)` -- the rotation is expressed purely through `Stat_table` consumed directly by the ground/gravity projection math. The player's angle now stays untouched for the whole stage, advancing the Slots bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 4 to frame 28 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:98656-99567`).
- **S3K Slots bonus stage no longer discards the player's subpixel fraction or drops the spawn-frame gravity tick:** `S3kSlotPlayerRuntime.syncPlayerToSlotOrigin`/`captureSlotOriginFromPlayer` used `setCentreX`/`setCentreY`/`getCentreX`/`getCentreY`, which truncate to whole pixels every frame, discarding the 16-bit subpixel fraction the runtime's own 16.16 `slotOrigin` accumulator tracked correctly (now round-tripped via `setCentreXPreserveSubpixel`/`setSubpixelRaw`/`getXSubpixelRaw`). Separately, ROM `Obj_Sonic_RotatingSlotBonus`'s routine-0 init handler falls straight through into the per-frame movement dispatcher on the object's own spawn frame (no intervening `rts`), applying one gravity/`MoveSprite2` tick before the first frame the trace fixture drives; `S3kSlotPlayerRuntime.initialize()` now primes that same fallthrough tick. Together these advance the Slots bonus-stage trace frontier from frame 0 to frame 4 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:98710-98784`).
- **S3K bonus-stage entry (Gumball/Pachinko) no longer forces the player airborne a frame early:** the headless fixture's generic pre-frame-0 ground-snap probe has no ROM equivalent for bonus-stage spawns -- `SpawnLevelMainSprites`'s zone air/animation branches are skipped whenever `Special_bonus_entry_flag` is set, so the ground-to-air transition is decided exclusively by frame 0's own `Player_AnglePos` probe. Resetting the fixture's forced `Status_InAir` before the first driven frame advances the Gumball and Pachinko bonus-stage trace frontiers from frame 0 to frames 27 and 46 respectively (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:7619,8117-8118,38160-38183,61896`).

- S1 special stage: read-only comparison snapshot accessors for trace replay (multi-stage trace run spec addition #2).
- Trace framework: s1_special_stage trace schema (14-column physics.csv frame record + profile-gated loader) for the S1 maze trace pipeline.
- Trace replay: per-game special-stage launch config helper (dormant S3K fresh-load seam).
- Trace replay: fresh_load metadata drives the S3K special-stage launch config.
- Trace framework: run_manifest.json schema + TraceRunManifest parser/validator for multi-segment trace runs (spec 2026-07-18).
- Trace framework: per-segment run_id/segment_index/bonus_stage_type metadata fields.
- Trace replay: bonus-stage bootstrap seam (applyBonusStageEntry) for s3k_bonus_stage segments.
- Trace replay: non-consuming transition peeks for chained run replay.
- Trace replay: BONUS_STAGE playback bridge (cursor/input feed during bonus interiors).
- Trace framework: run-replay walker promoted to src/main for visual run sessions.
- Trace framework: `TraceCatalog` discovers multi-segment `run_manifest.json` runs alongside ordinary traces; `TraceEntry.forRun`/`isRun`/`displayLabel` surface them to the trace test-mode picker.
- Trace framework: visual multi-stage trace run session in `TraceSessionLauncher` (`launchRun`/`finishRunLaunch`) drives a `RunSegmentAdvancer` state machine from a new all-mode `GameLoop` hook, re-seeking BK2 playback and rebinding the comparator/HUD/camera at each segment boundary (LEVEL/BONUS_STAGE/SPECIAL_STAGE via TITLE_CARD); held rewind is not installed for run sessions (documented follow-up).
- Trace replay: run segments pause on first divergence like segment 0.
- **S3K Super/Hyper forms now require the native second jump-button press:** Sonic transforms only when elemental shields and invincibility do not take priority (the basic shield remains compatible), main-player Tails requires all seven Super Emeralds while CPU Tails continues into flight, and Knuckles checks Chaos/Super Emerald progression before falling back to glide. The conversion flag, in-progress transformation timing, palette state, and character-specific physics now round-trip through save/rewind state (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:23470-23515,26264-26336,32545-32620`).
- **HCZ Jawz now reproduces its harmful vulnerable-contact explosion:** when a non-attacking player touches Jawz, it creates the short-lived `$8B` HCZ explosion child at the same native position, hurts through mapping frame 2, then finishes the standard explosion animation instead of disappearing harmlessly (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:141531-141548,142183-142188,142381-142383,183523-183557`).
- **S3K vertical and diagonal springs now restore control when they launch a hurt character:** the shared spring paths mirror their unconditional `routine=2` writes, ending hurt routine 4 immediately so input, upward-speed capping, and water-exit air reset resume instead of leaving Sonic or Tails trapped in low-gravity recoil (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:47719-47733,48093-48148,48186-48222,48292-48310`).
- **MGZ2's surprise Robotnik now stays behind foreground terrain:** the folded Robotnik-ship child mirrors `Child_SyncDraw`'s parent `art_tile` priority bit, so the normal Act 2 drilling appearances retain `ObjDat_MGZDrillBoss`'s low priority while the end boss keeps its explicit high-priority override (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:138841-138854,142389-142452,142720-142770`).
- **HCZ2's geyser handoff now starts MGZ1 music after the destination load:** the carried post-results fade can no longer silence Marble Garden when the player reaches it through normal progression.
- **Per-game rewind profiles now retain the VHS rewind presentation:** the effect pass prewarms whenever `rewind.vhsEffect` is enabled, so a launch-profile override that enables rewind after graphics initialization no longer leaves live rewind without its shader.
- **MGZ2's end boss now follows the native presentation, attack, rescue, and character-specific completion paths:** Robotnik's parent and child SSTs use their ROM priority planes and defeat ordering; the zoom telegraph is generated from the verified raw raster with native scaling and isolated per-instance atlas banks so a second live or rewound boss cannot overwrite an already queued cue; air-attack positioning, hit palettes, and the terrain-phase kill gate follow the disassembly; Sonic's rescue transition observes native routine/render visibility, deferred camera capture, carry/regrab cadence, and replacement Tails liveness; and Knuckles receives the separate `$A2` ground fight, eight-hit collision, seeded drill phases, upright capsule, camera/results waiter, and control restoration. The floor-impact handoff no longer emits a transient player-death SFX, and the terminal foreground VScroll frame no longer flashes wrapped MGZ wall tiles (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:142720-143205,143998-144842`).
- **AIZ's seamless Act 1-to-Act 2 route now retains ROM path-switch priority through both boss handoffs:** the results and late-forest display-bucket overrides no longer take ownership of Sonic's `art_tile` priority, while the waterfall-boss activation republishes the `$3F68` handoff for all engine players so direct and rewound entries retain the high-priority bit (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:39780-39850`).
- **S3K invisible-object diagnostics no longer leak into normal rendering:** AutoSpin triggers, InvisibleBlocks and their hurt variants, and TwistedRamps now expose collision/trigger geometry only through the dedicated object-debug overlay.
- **HCZ's seamless Act 1-to-Act 2 descent now includes the retained miniboss-controller bubbles:** the end-sign controller creates one ROM-backed Bubbler particle per frame for its native 48-dispatch window; each particle uses the original shared RNG word, fixed-point downward motion, carrier-axis oscillation, flicker phase, render bounds, and lifetime (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:139523-139566,139950-140002`).
- **S3K sinking-mud collision outlines no longer leak into normal gameplay rendering:** object `$4F` remains invisible unless the dedicated object-debug overlay is enabled, removing the one-host-pixel white boxes seen across MGZ mud volumes.
- **AIZ1 intro water splashes now cover the Tornado aircraft as in the ROM:** Super Sonic, the plane body, propeller, and rocket booster use sprite priority `$280` (bucket 5), while the waves use `$100` (bucket 2), restoring the native foreground ordering (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:135492-135819`).
- **Live S3K lost-ring floor probes again start from the native four-count V-int phase:** ordinary gameplay no longer depends on trace metadata to establish Obj37's floor-check cadence. Legacy replay fixtures continue to express their reconstructed absolute start phase, which the replay bootstrap now converts to an offset from the live game-rule baseline (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:543,35624-35635`).
- **Riding push preservation now reads the live player status byte:** a later preserving solid slot can retain `Status_Push` established by an earlier slot in the same `ExecuteObjects` pass, while a clear live bit still prevents geometry from inventing push state. This restores the native visibility window used by folded CPZ staircase pieces and the ARZ boss arrow before CPU Tails samples leader status (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:56025-56033,65658-65702`).
- **Deferred controller-driven solid releases now preserve an intervening re-landing:** when a later solid slot has already seated the player on a replacement support, the former support's deferred native release clears only its own standing bit instead of forcing the player airborne and discarding the new ride (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:41016-41035`).
- **Batched solid push releases now retain the native Walk/Run publication owner:** legacy post-movement collision passes pair the released object's prior-pass push latch with the player's frame-start `Status_Push`, matching the inline `Solid_NoCollision` path when movement has already cleared the live player bit (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm:251-263`).
- **Standalone MGZ physics and animation traces are now fully green:** the route-8 end capsule uses the ROM's MGZ-specific raised hover target, preventing its folded parent solid from falsely side-colliding with flying CPU Tails, while the parent solid and separately refreshed button retain their distinct native X phases. Physics advances from frame 35200 / 43 errors to green, animation advances from frame 35279 / 29 errors to green, and the full fleets improve to 45/58 physics plus 44/58 animation (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:181501-181545,181626-181637,181739-181767`).
- **Released MGZ rescue Tails now publishes generated flap input to `Ctrl_2_logical`:** `loc_142E2`'s auto-flight threshold pulse was already driving movement but was absent from the ROM-visible CPU input latch. Publishing that existing decision advances standalone MGZ physics from frame 34404 to 35200 while animation remains at 35279 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:27024-27067,27138-27160`).
- **Obj37 lost rings now defer clearing collision until their collection SST pass:** `Touch_ChkValue` can leave routine-4 ring collision visible to the following player slot, preventing P2 from skipping to and collecting a second overlapping ring in the same frame. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 30753 to 34404 while animation remains at 35279 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:20656-20789,35520-35676`).
- **S3K lost-ring floor probes now include active background collision geometry:** `Ring_FindFloor` scans foreground and the camera-difference-adjusted background layout while `Background_collision_flag` is set, allowing spilled rings to bounce from MGZ's raised background floor instead of falling through it. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 30714 to 30753 while animation remains at 35279 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:19369-19448,20098-20110,35520-35645`).
- **S3K grounded background collision now restores `sub_F846`'s fatal floor-overlap tail:** after `AnglePos`, stand/roll paths probe `FindFloor` from `y_pos-4` and enter `Kill_Character` on a negative dual-plane result before applying the existing BG wall clamps. This advances standalone MGZ physics from frame 30178 to 30714 and animation from 30178 to 35279 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:19946-19973,27520-27548,27732-27760`).
- **MGZ continuous screen shake now uses the global ROM-visible level counter:** `ShakeScreen_Setup` indexes `ScreenShakeArray2` with `Level_frame_counter`, so the engine no longer shifts quake phase after a seamless act/event-counter handoff. The corrected camera-copy visibility boundary advances standalone MGZ physics from frame 28680 to 30178, aligning it with animation (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:104188-104234,106257-106309`).
- **MGZ drilling Robotnik escape routines now retain their independent child hurt SSTs:** routines `$16`/`$18` still finish through `Draw_And_Touch_Sprite`, so the folded drill tip and lower hazards remain in the collision list while the flashing parent body stays disabled. The restored CPU Tails hurt contact advances standalone physics from frame 28207 to 28680 and animation from 28207 to 30178 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:142415-142425,142477-142515,144374-144415`).
- **MGZ trigger-platform screen shake now follows the native camera-copy phase:** inactive platform routines no longer erase another SST's live constant-shake flag, the completion pass suppresses the flag it clears natively, and the continuous sample accounts for `ShakeScreen_Setup` preparing the following frame's `Camera_Y_pos_copy`. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 27335 to 28207 while animation remains at 28207 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:70910-71029,104188-104234,106257-106309`).
- **MGZ swinging-platform cosine residue now follows the native SST slot:** `GetSineCosine` preserves a live `d1` high word that gives slots 6 and 7 distinct repeating endpoint-rounding angle sets. Separating those sets clears the standalone swinging-platform ride and advances MGZ physics from frame 25759 to 27335 without regressing the complete run; animation remains at 28207 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:3021-3029,70468-70543`).

Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 24211 to 24875 and animation from frame 24211 to 28207 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:70883-70892`).
- **S3K invisible blocks now clear residual ground speed on a stationary left-side contact:** `SolidObjectFull2` treats `x_vel == 0` as not moving away on that side, so the engine now preserves the native four-pixel separation while clearing stale `ground_vel`. - **MGZ Mantis now preserves the two-pass `Obj_WaitOffscreen` handoff:** the retained placeholder render flag restores the saved Mantis operation without also requiring its center to enter the viewport, and the visual child is allocated on the following SST pass. This restores the native child/swinging-platform slot order and advances standalone MGZ physics from frame 23562 to 23891 while animation remains at 23897 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:180266-180298,185700-185840`).
- **Obj37 now clears the shared ring count when its owner SST actually executes:** if a later object-slot hurt allocates the S3K bouncing-ring owner into an already-passed slot, `Ring_count=0` waits for that owner's next `Obj37_Init` pass; owners before the loop or ahead of the cursor retain same-pass behavior. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 23462 to 23562 while animation remains at 23897 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:21065-21110,35549-35616`).
- **S3K's collision-response list now retains every object that explicitly publishes:** `Add_SpriteToCollisionResponseList` has no camera-distance gate, so spilled rings beside an off-screen CPU Tails remain in native SST order subject only to the `$7E`-byte capacity. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 23264 to 23462 while animation remains at 23897 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:21200-21210,35616-35645`).
- **S3K floating-platform top collision now honors the caller's object render flag:** `Obj_FloatingPlatform` invokes `SolidObjectTop` only while its own `render_flags` sign bit is set, so an off-screen MGZ platform no longer catches Tails below the viewport; the exact `width_pixels`/`height_pixels` extents drive that gate. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 23046 to 23264 and animation from frame 23047 to 23897 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:50758-50853`).
- **Collapsing S3K bridge wave release now clears the rider's pushing status:** `Check_CollapsePlayerRelease` clears `Status_Push` together with `Status_OnObj` before setting `Status_InAir`, preventing a terrain-wall response from leaking its transient push bit past the later bridge slot. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 21890 to 23046 while animation remains at frame 23047 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:45349-45383`).
- **Collapsing S3K bridges now release their placement bit while their fragment SST remains alive:** standard and MGZ-stomp bridges detach the transformed parent into dynamic lifetime, allowing the later Camera-Y placement pass to create a fresh bridge exactly as `ObjPlatformCollapse_SmashObject` clears `respawn_addr` bit 7; trigger-mode bridges retain their deliberate no-respawn behavior. Standalone MGZ physics advances from frame 21808 to 21890 and animation from frame 21809 to 23047 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:45125-45420`).
- **MGZ pulley grabs now consume the playable's native `render_flags.on_screen` state:** `sub_349BA` checks the published sign bit rather than a strict point-in-camera predicate, so a held Tails remains attached through BuildSprites' lower viewport margin and continues following the extending handle. Standalone physics advances from frame 21734 to 21808 and animation from 21767 to 21809 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:36336-36364,71242-71286`).
- **MGZ pulley extension now follows the ROM's P1-owned grab byte while still carrying P2:** `loc_34900` consults only `$38(a0)` when choosing extension motion, while the later `sub_349A2` pass independently repositions a grabbed Tails from `$39(a0)`. After Sonic releases, the P2-only pulley therefore relaxes by two pixels per frame and carries Tails with it, advancing standalone physics from frame 21696 to 21734 and animation from 21765 to 21767 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:71178-71345`).
- **Waiting MGZ Mantis slots now keep `collision_flags` clear until initialization:** `Obj_WaitOffscreen` parents expose collision `$1A` only after `SetUp_ObjAttributes`, preventing a second false Tails contact and advancing standalone physics to frame 21696 and animation to frame 21765 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:180266-180298,185700-185729`).
- **Offscreen MGZ Mantis instances now remain in `Obj_WaitOffscreen`:** uninitialized parents no longer run their jump cycle or allocate a child outside the native `$20`/`$22` placeholder bounds, preventing a false Tails enemy bounce and advancing standalone physics and animation together to frame 20873; the later-slot swinging-platform sine residue also accepts the equivalent folded slot-6 representation (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:180266-180298,185700-185840,70468-70543`).
- **MGZ moving-spike jumps now preserve the platform's own `SolidObjectFull` unseat pass:** an earlier solid checkpoint can no longer consume Obj56's per-object standing state, preventing an exact-boundary fresh-contact Y snap and advancing standalone physics from frame 17092 to 20834 and animation from 17119 to 20868 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:41017-41035,41066-41084,71029-71114`).
- **MGZ Spiker top springs now retain the native `Obj_Wait` setup and zero passes:** the `$10` cooldown is not decremented in the child slot that installs it and collision `$CA` returns only after signed underflow, preventing an exact-edge Tails retrigger and advancing standalone physics from frame 16292 to 17092 and animation from 16304 to 17119 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:185465-185563,177949-177959`).
- **MGZ drilling-Robotnik hits now become visible after the current movement routine:** matching `MGZ2_SpecialCheckHit`'s post-dispatch order prevents a hang-state contact from starting the ceiling escape one pass early, while the gradual camera worker now relies on native `AllocateObject` slot execution without a synthetic wrapped-slot skip; standalone physics advances from frame 16055 to 16292 and MGZ complete-run remains green (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:142389-142436,142620-142706,178159-178198`).
- **MGZ's retained title-card exit now avoids double-counting phase-owned wait dispatches:** seamless title requests carry an explicit phase-one exit overlap, releasing `End_of_level_flag` and normal camera tracking on the native boundary while preserving phase-0 MGZ complete-run and HCZ timing; standalone physics advances from frame 14529 to 16055 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:62244-62279,62708-62720,106307-106345`).
- **MGZ's retained results-to-title-card handoff now avoids double-counting phase-owned child dispatches:** seamless title requests carry an explicit phase-one overlap, so `Obj_TitleCardWait` resets rings/timer on frame 14424 in standalone replay without shifting the phase-0 MGZ complete-run or HCZ handoffs, advancing standalone physics to frame 14529 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:62214-62235,62708-62720,106307-106345`).
- **MGZ miniboss collision now dereferences its live post-movement SST position:** `Obj_MGZMiniboss` moves before `Draw_And_Touch_Sprite` publishes the collision-list pointer, restoring Sonic's exact-edge boss rebound and advancing standalone physics from frame 12821 to 14424 and animation from frame 12863 to 16304 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:184817-184834,20656-20708,20895-20922`).
- **MGZ standalone replay now restores the complete native Obj37 slot cadence:** reconstructing the missing schema-v6 `V_int_run_count` low bits from observed SST bounce order prevents a stale frame-12457 ring collection and advances standalone physics to frame 12821 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:543,35593-35645,35965-35980`).
- **MGZ stomp bridges now preserve `SolidObjectTop`'s relative landing result:** the bridge seats a top-platform-carried player using the live enlarged radius before `Player_TouchFloor` restores ordinary radii, advancing standalone MGZ physics from frame 10842 to 12457 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:24335-24390,41982-42039,45170-45218`).
- **Shared S3K trace fixtures now retain elemental-shield object lifecycles:** replacement playable rosters are rebound to the retained object manager, restoring lightning double-jump spark slots and advancing standalone MGZ physics from frame 10589 to 10842 and animation from frame 10590 to 12863 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:34742-34858`).
- **S3K attracted-ring sparkles now preserve their native SST animation and delete phases:** `loc_1A920` inherits the attract routine's animation timer, holds each sparkle mapping for `delay+1` object passes, and leaves `$FC` deletion to the following pass, restoring MGZ's slot-19 attraction and subsequent slot-11 placement order (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:35710-35841,36157-36231`).
- **MGZ moving-spike platforms now expose their native `$18` balance width:** Sonic's on-object balance reads the SST `width_pixels` byte rather than the padded full-solid width or generic `$10` fallback, advancing standalone animation from frame 9880 to 10590 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:22440-22487,71029-71114`).
- **MGZ standalone replay now restores its captured Obj37 V-int low-bit phase:** schema-v6 recorded the adjacent V-int word rather than S3K's byte counter, so trace-start phase metadata prevents a false lost-ring terrain bounce and advances standalone physics from frame 9962 to 10589 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:543,35593-35645,35965-35980`).
- **MGZ moving-spike hurt now restores the native pre-movement Y position:** `sub_24280` subtracts `y_vel<<8` from the full 16:16 `y_pos` before `HurtCharacter`, preserving the exact integer/subpixel position through the rolling-radius reset and advancing standalone MGZ physics from frame 9838 to 9962 and animation from 9879 to 9880 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:49180-49219,71029-71114`).
- **S3K Tails follow nudges now ignore unrelated objects that reuse a released interact slot:** the fast-leader spring/wall suppression applies only when the live slot object is the support Tails actually latched, restoring native `loc_13E34` movement and advancing standalone MGZ physics from frame 7582 to 9838 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:26690-26741`).
- **MGZ top-platform riders now observe the native pre-movement solid pass:** ordinary riders receive neither post-move horizontal carry nor post-move Y seating, while Tails' edge-balance check reads the platform's actual `$18` width; standalone MGZ advances from physics frame 7346 to 7582 and animation frame 7366 to 9879 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:71475-71584,71729-71763,72045-72064`).
- **S3K speed-shoes cadence now reads the actual low byte of `Level_frame_counter`:** 68k `(Level_frame_counter+1).w` addresses the second byte of the word rather than adding one to its value, so the every-eighth-frame decrement aligns at low-byte zero; standalone MGZ advances from physics frame 6496 to 7346 and animation frame 6524 to 7366 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:22067-22095`).

- **S3K Tunnelbot touch checks now dereference the live post-movement SST position:** `Sprite_CheckDeleteTouch` publishes the object RAM pointer after Tunnelbot moves, so the following player pass must not use the engine's one-frame-older pre-update coordinate; removing that false inclusive-edge attack bounce advances standalone MGZ physics from frame 2475 to 5548 and animation from frame 2496 to 6465 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:184710-184723,20656-20708,21200-21210`).

- **MGZ horizontal boss-body touch now observes the native live collision-list position:** pattern-zero air sweeps publish the parent after its remaining object/V-int phases while diagonal bodies and folded drill children retain their own phases, restoring the frame-37920 rebound and advancing complete-run physics to frame 38184 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:142969-143017,143271-143321`).
- **Tails carry now publishes native positive `object_control=$03`:** Sonic's movement and normal animator remain suppressed while TouchResponse stays active, and the carry word clears on Tails' following hurt-routine entry; pattern-zero boss children also retain their already-published horizontal position, advancing MGZ complete-run physics from frame 37412 to 37920 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:21973-22022,27222-27415,29180-29192,142969-143017,143271-143321`).
- **MGZ folded drill touch regions now publish from the later native child slots:** during the moving air attack, the drill children observe the parent's post-`MoveSprite2` position before joining `Collision_response_list`, advancing complete-run physics from frame 37411 to 37412 and reducing its remaining errors from 384 to 154 (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:142969-142997,143271-143321`).
- **Sonic 2 WFZ's jump-to-plane layout patch now targets the ROM background cells:** ObjB2 decodes `Level_Layout` offsets using the native interleaved 128-byte foreground/128-byte background row format, so the four landing-time writes update Plane B source cells at x `$52/$56` instead of being treated as invalid 256-wide foreground coordinates.
