HTZ2 joins the green animation fleet and the 19-route total falls from 351 to 292 grouped errors while the cross-game physics baseline remains 42/58 (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:35193-35207,39297-39300,40484-40491,65565-65591`).
- **Sonic 2 solid, spindash, and sidekick animation ownership now follows the native frame boundary:** exact-edge CPZ/HTZ contacts remain solid, Obj36 holds its initialization frame, active spindash state no longer continuously overwrites object-published bytes, and S2 Tails' respawn approach preserves the ROM animation/status bytes until a later routine owns them. CPZ1, CPZ2, HTZ1, and CNZ1 join the green animation fleet, taking Sonic 2 from 6/19 routes and 417 grouped errors to 10/19 and 351 without changing the cross-game physics or S1/S3K animation baselines (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:29362-29389,35138-35176,35462-35509,39122-39228,40470-40587`).
- **Sonic 2 landing and release animation state now follows the native routine owner:** ordinary solid landings clear tumble state, angled terrain landings publish Walk only for the S2 rule set, Grabber escape publishes Walk, same-frame death publishes the raw Death byte without replacing the current mapping, and Obj69 uses its separate `$20` balance width. Six ordinary S2 routes are green and the fleet falls from 2,381 to 417 grouped animation errors; the cross-game physics fleet also improves from 41/17 to 42/16 by greening MTZ3 (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:38049-38152,38627-38649,56382-56435`).
- **Sonic 2 animation ownership now follows native object, landing, tumble, oil-slide, and solid-release state:** spring and slide flags no longer overwrite explicit ROM animation bytes; `Player_JumpFlip` advances only in the airborne player routine; S2 `SolidObject_TestClearPush` preserves Roll; moving platforms expose their native balance widths/coordinates; and the SCZ Tornado alone opts into rider-owned deep Wait/Blink progression. Five ordinary S2 routes are green and the fleet falls from 8,233 to 2,381 animation errors while the 41/58 cross-game physics baseline remains unchanged (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:35464-35476,37780-37786,38449-38505,47363,79602-79603`).
- **Sonic 2 native push, hurt, and Tails respawn animation ownership is restored:** ground pushing retains raw Walk and enters the push mapping sub-handler only when the shared walk timer permits it; `Hurt_Sidekick` publishes `$1A` for both characters; Tails' existing Fly script cadence survives CPU respawn entry; and Tails tumble mappings use their own `$75` base. Every ordinary S2 animation trace improves, reducing the fleet from 14,506 to 8,233 errors without changing the cross-game physics baseline (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:38449-38505,38627-38649,39116-39140,41405-41435,85497-85519`).
- **Sonic 2 Tails now uses the retail third locomotion tier and slope-bank layout:** the private `$1F` HaulAss script is selected at effective speed `$700` without changing the raw Walk animation byte, and Tails' exact walk/run/HaulAss slope strides are modeled as `4/3/3` instead of inferred from script length. Sliding doubles animation-purpose speed before tier selection, matching `TAnim_WalkRunZoom` (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:41366-41401,41553,41622-41623`).
- **Sonic 2 Sonic walk/run mappings now use the retail publication cadence:** `SAnim_WalkRun` publishes the mapping selected by the current `anim_frame` before it decrements and advances `anim_frame`, while Tails retains its distinct timer-first handler. The ordering is owned by the per-character scripted-animation profile, preserving S1 Sonic's timer-first behavior and restoring the same publish-first behavior for S3K characters (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:38494-38505,41330-41396`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:24859-24879`).
- **Sonic 1 slope-running frames no longer alternate into an upside-down pose:** delayed Walk/Run frames now retain the `obRender` X/Y flip bits paired with the already-latched mapping frame, matching `Sonic_Animate`'s early return before both fields. The S1 animation trace fleet remains 29/29 green (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:2253-2279`).
- **All Sonic 1 replay traces now pass animation/frame verification:** solid release publication is bounded to the paired native owner (with explicit folded-staircase and skipped-Obj33 states), S1 monitors, MZ bricks, and chained stompers retain their inclusive `bhi` right edge, and the one S1 left-braking path that reaches exactly zero inertia continues into the native Wait/Balance tail. The full 29-trace S1 fleet passes with zero physics or animation divergences; a focused regression also confirms that raw Walk ID `$00` and mapping `$1C` are the retail slope-bank result at angle `$18`.
- **Sonic 1 prison capsules now use their native unpadded width for edge balancing:** Obj3E keeps `obActWid=$20` for `Sonic_Move` while passing `$20+$B` only to `SolidObject`, preventing false Balance animation when Sonic stands safely inboard on the capsule body and greening GHZ3 (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/3E Prison Capsule.asm`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm`).
- **Sonic 1 ground animation publication now retains the exact native owner across MZ solid transitions:** an object's still-set push bit performs retail `Solid_NoCollision`'s Walk/Run word write even when Sonic's paired push bit was cleared earlier in the frame, opposite-direction braking that reaches zero can continue into Balance while the direction remains held, and Obj31 chained stompers expose their raw `$38/$30/$10` `obActWid` rather than the `$B`-extended collision width (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm:251-263`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:395-460,634-757`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/31 MZ Chained Stompers.asm:112-135,184-190`).
- **Sonic 1 moving-solid animation releases now follow their live SST state:** collapsing ledges publish the native `prev_anim=Run` restart when their forced-collapse routine releases Sonic; moving Obj36 spikes and Obj56 floating blocks keep `SolidObject` standing/pushing latches on the live instance as their coordinates change; and Obj33's skipped-checkpoint push fallback is limited to its active lava-motion state. - **Sonic 1 floating-block solid status now follows the live Obj56 SST:** oscillation rebuilds the engine's dynamic placement without changing the native standing/pushing owner, allowing later `Solid_NoCollision` cleanup to consume the correct latch and advancing SYZ1 from frame 1742 / 4 errors to frame 5761 / 3 errors (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/56 Floating Blocks and Doors.asm`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm`).
- **Sonic 1 running discs now publish their native first-attachment animation bytes:** a grounded non-rolling attach clears `obAnim` to Walk and always writes Run to `obPrevAni` after the player's animation pass, restarting Walk on the next player slot and advancing the SBZ2 complete-run animation frontier from frame 171 / 49 errors to frame 3377 / 1 error (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/67 Running Disc.asm`, `Disc_MoveSonic`).
- **Sonic 1 edge balancing now consumes the native owner state:** MZ grassy platforms, SBZ stomper doors, and FZ cylinders expose their raw `obActWid` instead of the `$B`-padded `SolidObject` width, while terrain balance uses the prior `angleright`/`angleleft` bytes rather than fresh side probes. - **Sonic 1 solid push release now pairs the object's prior checkpoint with the player's frame-start push bit:** a later object slot can execute retail `Solid_NoCollision` after movement has already cleared `Status_Push` and selected Wait, reproducing Obj30's one-frame Walk/Run word without accepting stale unpaired latches. Moving glass blocks also retain their live-SST latch and inclusive `SolidObject` edge (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/30 MZ Large Green Glass Blocks.asm`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm:251-263`).
- **Sonic 1 horizontal springs now toggle the player's existing facing bit exactly like `bchg`:** launch direction no longer overwrites the pre-contact facing state, restoring the ROM's slope-frame bank throughout the post-spring control lock and advancing the SYZ1 animation frontier from frame 690 to 1742 (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/41 Springs.asm:146-149`).
- **Forced logical movement now owns animation selection over hidden raw input:** after a signpost locks controls and writes Right to the logical pad, the same-direction movement helper publishes Walk even when the recorded raw pad still holds Left. - **Sonic 1 Labyrinth blocks now use their ROM subtype width for edge balancing:** Obj61 exposes its `LBlk_Var` `obActWid` independently from the extra `$B` passed only to `SolidObject`, preventing wide SBZ3 platforms from selecting Balance while Sonic is safely inboard (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/61 LZ Blocks.asm`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm`).
- **Ground coasting now preserves the ROM animation owner until movement writes a replacement:** no-direction motion leaves explicit bytes such as WaterSlide untouched until the zero-speed Wait tail, and sub-threshold opposite-direction braking retains Stop until facing changes and same-direction acceleration publishes Walk. - **Sonic 1 spikes and floating blocks now retain `SolidObject`'s inclusive right edge:** equality at the caller's full-solid width remains a native side contact, preventing false object push-bit releases and animation restarts. - **Grounded rolling now preserves the ROM animation byte owned by roll entry or later object dispatch:** the shared velocity profile no longer rewrites Roll on every `MdRoll` frame, allowing S1 `SolidObject`'s retail push-release word to leave Walk active until another native routine changes it. Roll entry and same-direction `RollLeft`/`RollRight` input remain the explicit Roll publishers in all three games, while opposite-direction braking leaves the existing byte untouched (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:344-353,881-928,1165-1195`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm:254-265`; `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:36654-36675,36954-37161`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:22144-22166,22924-23269`).
- **Sonic 1 buttons now retain side contact at `SolidObject`'s inclusive right edge:** a player exactly flush with a button's right face keeps the native object/player push pair instead of intermittently taking `Solid_NoCollision`, preserving the ongoing push mapping cadence in SBZ3 (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/32 Button.asm`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm`).
- **Rolling jumps now preserve the animation byte owned before jump dispatch:** when `Sonic_Jump` begins with Status_Roll already set, its native `.rolljump` tail sets only the Roll-Jump bit instead of writing Roll; the shared animation profile now retains explicit owners such as LZ WaterSlide across that airborne arc. This advances the Sonic 1 LZ3 complete-run animation frontier without changing its green physics stream (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:1203-1274`; `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:37318-37397`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:23303-23363`).
- **Object-published Spring and LZ wind-tunnel animations now survive native ground-movement tails:** friction-only and opposite-direction braking paths no longer invent a Walk write, grounded facing flips publish the exact `prev_anim=Run` sentinel, and the shared animator restores `prev_anim` while the runtime water-tunnel flag remains active. This advances the Sonic 1 LZ2 and SYZ2 complete-run animation frontiers without changing their green physics streams (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:385-407,634-757`; `docs/s1disasm/_inc/LZWaterFeatures.asm:279-373`).
- **Playable scripts now restart from the ROM-visible final animation byte:** animation selection no longer resets cadence merely because an earlier owner wrote a transient animation in the same dispatch; the final `anim`/`prev_anim` comparison remains authoritative. This advances LZ2 from frame 2279 to 2293 and SBZ3 from frame 3178 to 3491, reducing SBZ3 to three animation errors.
- **Released braking input now preserves the ROM-owned Stop animation until its script changes it:** when inertia remains nonzero, the no-direction `Sonic_Move` path reaches `ResetScr` without writing `obAnim`; the shared velocity profile no longer treats the engine-only skid/dust flag clearing as a Walk write. This advances the Sonic 1 LZ3 and SLZ2 complete-run animation frontiers without changing their green physics streams (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:379-430,634-757`; `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:36880-36999`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:22792-22918`).
- **Sonic 1 floating blocks now use their ROM subtype width for edge balancing:** Obj56 exposes its `FBlock_Var` `obActWid` independently from the extra `$B` passed only to `SolidObject`, removing false Balance animation on wide SYZ platforms without changing their collision geometry (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/56 Floating Blocks and Doors.asm`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm`).
- **Movement animation now follows the ROM routine's dispatch-time state through LZ slide exits:** the final `locktime` tick retains the previously published animation even though `SlopeRepel` decrements the timer before animation, and a grounded WaterSlide write survives a later same-frame terrain detach when no jump/roll routine supersedes it. This advances the Sonic 1 LZ2 and LZ3 complete-run animation frontiers without changing their green physics streams (`docs/s1disasm/_inc/LZWaterFeatures.asm:468-513`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:379-430,1402-1435`).
- **Air-routine landings now publish the ROM-owned landing animation:** accepted terrain floor contacts write Walk before animation, while the shared player profile defers unrelated grounded Wait/Balance selection until the following frame. This matches the native routine boundary and advances the Sonic 1 MZ3 complete-run frontier from frame 813 to frame 2585 without changing its green physics stream.
- **Sonic 1 solid push release now publishes the retail ROM's adjacent animation word:** when a native solid push latch loses contact while `Status_Push` is still paired, the shared solid controller writes raw Walk with `prev_anim=Run`, restarting Walk on the following player animation pass. A typed S1-only object-interaction rule preserves the corrected S2/S3K clear path and avoids treating stale engine object latches as native releases (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm:251-263`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidWall.asm:36-51`).
- **Sonic 1 moving solids now retain the exact object-owned push-release state:** exact-right-edge contacts use the ROM's inclusive `bhi` bound, moving objects keep status latches on their live instance rather than a rebuilt position key, and the immediately previous per-object checkpoint can publish the Walk/Run word after movement has already cleared the player's push bit. Obj33 additionally preserves its SST latch across the falling states that skip `Solid_ChkEnter`. This clears the SLZ2 complete-run trace and advances the FZ, MZ1, MZ2, and SYZ3 animation frontiers without changing their green physics streams (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm:123-166,251-263`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/33 Pushable Blocks.asm`).
- **Terrain walk-off now publishes the ROM's exact `prev_anim=Run` state:** the shared `AnglePos` support-loss path restarts Roll2 when its raw animation remains Roll while preserving cadence when the raw animation is already Run. This advances the Sonic 1 GHZ2, LZ1, LZ2, SLZ2, and SLZ3 complete-run animation frontiers without changing their green physics streams (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/Sonic AnglePos.asm:113-115,276-278,349-351,422-424`; `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:43108-43110,43216-43218,43283-43285,43350-43352`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:18840-18842,18965-18967,19037-19039,19109-19111`).
- **Sonic 1 fresh level starts now execute the native pre-gameplay player pass:** the S1 level-init profile runs the newly cleared Sonic slot once before the first counted gameplay frame, and ground-to-air detachment preserves the Wait/Walk animation selected before `AnglePos` sets `Status_InAir`. This restores SBZ3's native frame-zero Wait animation and mapping without seeding player state from replay data (`GM_Level`; `Objects/Sonic.asm` `Sonic_Move` / `Sonic_AnglePos`).
- **Cross-game donor characters now retain the classic raw-Walk/rendered-Run animation contract:** translated player animation profiles preserve the ROM-backed high-speed animation-ID policy instead of silently reverting to a raw Run ID when donor art is installed.
- **Hurt recovery now preserves the ROM's explicit Walk animation byte for its landing frame:** the shared velocity-animation profile recognizes a frame that began in the hurt routine and completed recovery before animation, preventing zero inertia from replacing HurtStop's Walk write with Wait. This advances five S1 frontiers while retaining normal Wait selection on the following frame (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:1901-1951`; `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:38187-38226,41074-41114`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:24463-24506,29208-29251`).
- **Grounded facing changes now observe the ROM's post-slope inertia:** the shared movement path evaluates the `MoveLeft`/`MoveRight` facing-flip and `prev_anim=Run` restart after slope resistance, so an inertia zero-crossing restarts Walk on the same frame as `Status_Facing`. This advances the S1 MZ1 standalone animation frontier from frame 124 to frame 381 (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:283-291,634-659,704-723`).
- **Damage frames now publish the ROM's Hurt animation byte during touch response:** the shared hurt owner resolves canonical Hurt immediately after knockback state is installed, preserving the mapping already selected by the earlier animation pass. This advances the S1 GHZ1 standalone frontier from frame 387 to 437 and MZ2 complete-run from frame 308 to 354 (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:78-100`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/Sonic ReactToItem.asm:375-410`; `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:85471-85519`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:21065-21110`).
- **Playable animation delay frames now preserve the ROM's latched mapping:** the shared scripted animator decrements `obTimeFrame` before speed/slope script selection and returns without rewriting `obFrame` while the timer remains live. This advances the S1 SYZ2 complete-run animation frontier from frame 33 to frame 47 (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:2174-2193,2253-2282`).
- **Classic movement now keeps the ROM Walk animation byte while displaying speed-selected Run frames:** the shared velocity profile models the native split between `MoveLeft`/`MoveRight` publishing `anim=Walk` and `Animate_*` selecting the Run script at high inertia. This clears the newly verified raw-animation mismatch in the SBZ2, SLZ1, and GHZ3 Sonic 1 replays while preserving the same contract for Sonic 2 and Sonic 3&K (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:634-658,704-722,2253-2315`; `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:36880-36962,38473-38503`; `docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:22792-22877,24833-24879`).
- **Rolling landings now publish the ROM's Walk animation byte when they clear roll:** terrain and solid-object landing paths mirror `Sonic_ResetOnFloor` without re-running the already-completed animation pass, preserving the ball mapping on that frame while advancing the S1 GHZ2, MZ1, MZ3, and SBZ1 complete-run frontiers (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:1481-1561,1839-1864`; `docs/s1disasm/_incObj/sub SolidObject.asm:357-388`).
- **Zero-inertia movement now preserves the ROM's explicit Wait selection:** opposite-direction braking and grounded roll-stop frames retain Wait even while the direction remains held, while already-stationary and landing frames still select Walk. This advances the Sonic 1 GHZ1 complete-run animation frontier from frame 551 to 679 and SYZ1 from frame 135 to 433 without changing their green physics streams (`Objects/Sonic.asm:284-310,480-623`).
- **Sonic 1 grounded facing reversals now restart the walk animation at the native frame:** the shared movement path always publishes the ROM `prev_anim=Run` sentinel on a grounded direction flip, while S1's `FixBugs` distinction remains limited to the later push-bit clear. This advances the SYZ2 complete-run animation frontier from frame 11 to frame 33 (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:634-659,704-723,2174-2182`).
- **Sonic 1 pushing now retains the ROM's movement-selected Walk animation byte:** `Sonic_Animate` selects push mappings only when the shared special-animation timer expires, preserving the current walk/push mapping during intervening delay frames instead of restarting a separate Push animation script (`docs/s1disasm/_incObj/01 Sonic.asm:2174-2193,2253-2282,2353-2376`).
- **Legacy Sonic 1 credits traces now load their historical stable-retro CSV layout:** pre-v5 trace rows are decoded from their actual column count, resolving the historically overloaded `csv_version: 4` value without relaxing the structurally distinct v5-v7 schemas. All eight credits replay fixtures now run green through the comparison-only pipeline.
- **Trace replay now verifies playable animation independently from physics:** BizHawk CSV v7 records the ROM animation ID and displayed mapping frame for Player and Sidekick, the replay binder compares both without hydrating engine state, and `-Dtrace.verification=physics|animation|all` provides separate failure frontiers and report artifacts while animation parity is brought up.
- **Sonic 2 WFZ ending: Sonic now hangs correctly on the getaway ship and the ship-plating grab fires:** the Tornado end sequence re-forced the standing/WAIT animation every frame of `ObjB2_Jump_to_ship`, overwriting the invisible grabber's `HANG`; the ROM sets no animation in that state (`s2.asm:79082-79085`), so the hang now persists through the Death-Egg ascent. The grabber also applied bit-7 object control, which suppressed the whole touch pass and stopped the breakable-plating (obj 0xC1) from ever grabbing the hanging player; it now uses bit-0 control (`obj_control = 1`, `s2.asm:79217`) like the ROM, keeping `TouchResponse` alive so the grab works.
- **Sonic 2 WFZ boss (obj 0xC5) rewind recreate hardened against absent-spawn contexts:** the `WFZLaserWall` and `WFZFloatingPlatform` rewind recreate paths dereferenced `ctx.spawn()` without the null guard every sibling scan uses, and `updateDefeat` dereferenced the camera/game-state services unguarded; these now drop/no-op instead of throwing an `NullPointerException`, a candidate cause of the reported "rewind on WFZ boss crashes" (pending confirmation from an actual stack trace).
- **Sonic 2 WFZ boss (obj 0xC5) lens now sits behind its cover and the laser beam now harms the player:** the lens/shooter rendered at priority bucket 3 (in front of the cover at bucket 4), so it drew over the case and the "cover opens to expose the lens" reveal never happened; it now uses the ROM's sprite priority 5 (behind the case), matching `ObjC5_SubObjData3` (`s2.asm:82036-82038`). The laser beam child was not a `TouchResponseProvider`, so its per-stage `collision_flags` (`$AB..$AE`) were dead code and the beam passed harmlessly through Sonic; the beam now applies the ROM per-stage collision from `ObjC5_LaserShoot` (`s2.asm:81876,81895-81901`), retained through the sweep phase and independent of the display flicker (which the ROM only uses to gate `DisplaySprite`). The boss laser plays no charge/fire SFX — that is faithful to the ROM (ObjC5 issues no `PlaySound`; the loud laser is the separate pre-boss `ObjB9` cutscene turret).
- **Sonic 2 WFZ vertical propeller (obj 0xB4) helicopter sound is now localized to the screen:** the ROM plays `SndID_Helicopter` via `PlaySoundLocal`, which only queues the SFX when the object's `render_flags.on_screen` bit is set (`s2.asm:79683-79687,1555-1562`); the engine used the unconditional `playSfx`, so the propeller kept sounding across its whole off-screen placement window (~half the level). Now gated on `isOnScreen()`.
- **Sonic 2 WFZ rivet (obj 0xC2) now plays its explosion sound and drops the player into the room below:** busting the rivet spawned a silent explosion (the 4-arg `ExplosionObjectInstance` constructor defaults to `sfxId = -1`) and left the player pinned by the engine's riding-state latch, so no sound played and Sonic never fell. The rivet now spawns the explosion with `SndID_Explosion` ($C1, s2.asm:46728, matching ROM Obj27 init) and calls `clearRidingObject` before setting the player airborne, so the ROM's `bclr on_object` / `bset in_air` release (`s2.asm:81114-81115`) actually takes effect and Sonic falls through the opened floor.
- **Sonic 2 WFZ hook-on-chain (obj 0x80 MovingVine) chain and hook graphics fixed:** the WFZ variant is drawn with `make_art_tile(ArtTile_ArtNem_WfzHook_Fudge,1,0)` — mappings authored against tile base `$03FE` while the art loads at `$03FA` — but the loader ignored the +4 "fudge" offset, so the chain showed the leading art tiles and the hook rendered the chain tiles (garbled). The loader now applies the +4 tile offset (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:56667-56668`). Also gave the object a proper debug bounding box and moved its debug label to the bottom of the object.
- **Sonic 2 WFZ belt platform (obj 0xBD) now uses its ROM palette line:** the ascending/descending metal platform is `make_art_tile(ArtTile_ArtNem_WfzBeltPlatform,3,1)` — palette line 3 — but the art loader passed `2` under a mistaken "index conversion" that no other object loader applies, tinting the platform wrong (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:80559`).
- **Sonic 2 WFZ palette-switcher (obj 0x8B) debug box now respects the live debug overlay toggle:** the invisible trigger drew its box whenever the `debug.flags.debugView` subsystem was enabled, ignoring the F1 overlay toggle, so the box stayed on screen with the HUD hidden; it now also requires `DebugOverlayToggle.OVERLAY`, matching the Sonic 1 junction object.
- **Sonic 2 WFZ Tornado now plays the scatter sound as it is gunned down, not the ring-loss jingle:** the shot-down state (`ObjB2_Main_WFZ_Start_shot_down`) emits `SndID_Scatter` (`$EB`) every `$20` frames while the plane falls, matching the ROM; it previously played `SndID_RingSpill` (`$C6`), the sound of the player losing rings, so being shot down sounded like getting hurt (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:78890-78895`).
- **StillSprites (obj 0x2F) now live their ROM `Sprite_OnScreen_Test` lifetime, restoring HCZ waterfall curtains and tube-crossing pieces:** the exact-screen despawn check deleted every placement-spawned StillSprite on its first update (spawns sit beyond the screen edge), so decorative overlays across AIZ/HCZ/MGZ/LBZ/MHZ/LRZ vanished — most visibly HCZ's waterfall curtains and HCZ2's slide-crossing tube pieces, which cut off in sprite-sized blocks; the despawn now uses the coarse `(camX-$80)&$FF80..+$280` window (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:37262-37277`). Known knock-on: the `s3k_hcz` complete-run trace now diverges by one field (f29096 rings, 3 frames early scattered-ring re-collect at the end boss) — recorded in `docs/status/trace-frontier-log.md`.
- **HCZ2 Plane B now stays a 512px VDP window through the whole act, fixing blocky waterfall/background corruption:** the wall-chase states drive the window from the wall BG camera like the ROM's `DrawBGAsYouMove` (`Camera_X_pos_BG_copy = camX-$200+wall offset`), with raw row-pointer overflow so columns past the wall strip stay blank instead of wrapping into the normal strip; the BG high-priority replays now bias each scanline's BG scroll word into window-local coordinates and wrap at the plane period, mirroring the compositing pass's `ScrollMidpoint`/FBO width, so waterfall curtains and the chase wall no longer sample the wrong 512px strip in per-band rectangles; background chunk selection uses floored modulo so windows left of the layout build blank chunks instead of crashing (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:106033-106178`).
- **HCZ rewind now closes results and end-boss object ownership:** results-screen element timelines, the egg-capsule button parent, and blade-impact boss links are captured through the central compact schema, with graph restores proving fresh-object identity and reference closure.
- **HCZ Turbo Spiker shells now transfer lifetime ownership when launched:** `loc_87D72` severs the obsolete badnik link, the detached shell and its trail retain the native `Sprite_CheckDeleteTouchXY` bounds and one-entry delete marker, and rewind reconstruction preserves the captured spawn metadata. This removes the frame-14211 rewind reference-closure failure without weakening closure validation (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:179032-179047,179136-179139,184034-184083`).
- **HCZ1 miniboss vortex bubbles now retain their native fractional pull:** the bubble child preserves the low word of its 16.16 position while accumulating signed 8.8 horizontal velocity and half-pixel vertical steps, preventing far-left bubbles from freezing and matching `sub_6AA30` throughout the spin sequence (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:140265-140315`).
- **HCZ2 now discards the opening chase wall when the ROM refreshes Plane B:** after the wall-clear state, the renderer rebuilds a 64-cell nametable from the normal X=$000 background strip instead of retaining the full layout where later HScroll can reach the wall strip again. HCZ priority replays also preserve the complete 224-line HScroll table rather than flattening normal parallax to the final scanline (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:106085-106125,106179-106212`).

- **Sonic 1 donor sprites now retain their blue character palette in Sonic 3&K, including underwater:** cross-game palette loading resolves `Pal_Sonic` through the ROM revision's `PalPointers` entry instead of reading the REV00 data address unconditionally; water rendering now installs Sonic 1's native `Pal_LZSonWater` character line in the donor palette block, with host-derived tinting retained as the fallback for donors without a native underwater palette.
- **HCZ's results and dual-geyser ending now reach MGZ on the native object lifecycle:** the HCZ2 results owner retains the boss camera bounds and remaining child-SST retire dispatches, `loc_6B154` restores the signed controller locks, and the primary geyser allocates a delayed P2-targeted helper whose carry lifetime remains subordinate to the primary `$5F` transition timer (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:62679-62693,140986-141006,141545-141633`).
- **HCZ's post-results geyser now waits on the native results-lifetime owner:** the capsule no longer treats the already-set `End_of_level_flag` as results completion; it waits for the `_unkFAA8`-equivalent active-results state to clear before creating `loc_6B7BC`, preventing the shake, rise, and carry sequence from starting hundreds of frames early (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:140986-141006,141545-141623`).
- **HCZ's capsule/results handoff now preserves native P1/P2 slot timing:** the capsule applies `Set_PlayerEndingPose` to P1 first, retains an established button ride under bit-7 object control, and queues P2's later eligible pose so Tails completes the current no-input physics/subpixel step before `Check_TailsEndPose` clears the signed controller lock and zeroes velocity (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:181900-181940,181977-181990,41016-41035,41390-41442`).
- **HCZ's ground egg capsule now creates and consumes its native separate solid button slot:** the button at `y_pos-$24` owns a same-slot `SolidObjectFull` checkpoint with dimensions `$1B/$04/$06`, publishes its standing bit to the earlier capsule parent, and the next parent entry opens the capsule and sets the signed P2 controller lock after Tails' current CPU slot (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:181496-181555`).
- **HCZ end-boss defeat now preserves the native camera-release ramp:** the hit-frame dispatch no longer consumes the newly installed `$3F` wait; flee uses constant `MoveSprite` velocity and `Obj_Wait` underflow timing; and `loc_6B0E8` creates a rewind-safe `$4000`-accelerating `Child6_IncLevX` helper instead of jumping live `Camera_max_X_pos` directly to its stored target (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:140937-140969,142015-142044,177944-177952,178154-178169`).

- **HCZ end-boss fired blades now use the native flight, slowdown, and impact cadence:** `MoveSprite_LightGravity` moves with the old velocity before adding `$20`; `Animate_RawGetFaster` keeps its script counters distinct from the floor-hit callback; chute setup defers `Obj_Wait` until its next SST pass; and `loc_6B77C` now creates the native `$8B` harmful impact animation instead of a visual-only explosion (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:141287-141307,141445-141549,177749-177792`).
- **HCZ end-boss turbine slowdown now retains its native long collision tail and response-list phase:** routine 8 follows `Animate_RawGetSlower`'s increasing delay through `loc_6B262`; while slowing, player touch consumes the frame-start child coordinate, whereas active/wind-down helpers retain their refreshed-coordinate contract, restoring Tails' later native turbine hit (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:141019-141106,177806-177837`).
- **HCZ end-boss pre-attack timing now keeps the literal ROM countdown:** `loc_6B01E` stores `$FF` exactly, while the consolidated setup dispatch publishes `loc_6B03A` separately without adding another swing/movement step; this removes the earlier synthetic `$100` timer compensation (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:140934-140973,177944-177952`).
- **HCZ end-boss turbine collision now survives the slowdown animation:** `loc_6B244` selects routine 8 without clearing `$A6`; the hurt byte remains active until `Animate_RawGetSlower` reaches `loc_6B262`, restoring the final native player contact before the turbine returns to its wait routine (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:141084-141106,142249-142257,177749-177792`).
- **HCZ end-boss attack and water-column descent now retain their native callback tails:** the folded pre-attack setup remains distinct from the `$FF` `Obj_Wait` countdown, and the later `loc_6B3DE` spray slot completes one final suction/grab dispatch after the column parent selects descent (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:140934-140973,141084-141106,141205-141239,177944-177952`).
- **Idle HCZ twisting loops now release their SST slots off-screen:** `loc_3909C` sends the controller through `Delete_Sprite_If_Not_In_Range` whenever neither native player has an active loop phase; only a captured P1/P2 keeps the invisible controller persistent, allowing ordinary placement respawn while restoring later end-boss/lost-ring allocation cadence (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:76482-76505,37262-37277`).

- **HCZ water-column spray now completes its native rise-callback dispatch:** when the parent changes from rise to hold at five segments, its later spray SST still performs that frame's grab/carry interaction instead of re-testing the mutated parent routine and skipping the final `$80` velocity step (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:141084-141106,141226-141239,142090-142110`).
- **HCZ end-boss turbine touch now uses its refreshed child coordinate:** `loc_6B1A8` calls `Refresh_ChildPosition` immediately before adding the turbine to the collision-response list, preventing a one-frame-stale exact-edge hurt while leaving other objects' snapshot contracts unchanged (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:141019-141033,178139-178153`).
- **HCZ end-boss turbines now create their water column from the native spin-up callback:** `Animate_RawGetFaster` completes its decreasing-delay sequence before `loc_6B212` allocates the column, preventing premature spray suction while the turbine is still accelerating; the folded column animation also preserves `Animate_Raw`'s pre-decrement callback cadence (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:141030-141069,141107-141131,142241-142257,177328-177372,177749-177792`).
- **HCZ breakable bars now read raw controller holds while carrying players:** Obj36 no longer treats CPU Tails' generated `Ctrl_2_logical` directions as manual P2 input, so captured movement and release follow the native `(Ctrl_2).w` word (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:42770-42836,42924-42990`).
- **HCZ large fans now retain their shared KosM queue warm state:** the first Obj39 activation preserves the longer still-busy module workload, while later activations consume the already-primed queue one object dispatch sooner; the cross-activation state is rewind-captured (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:65583-65636`).
- **HCZ2 trigger-collapse tension bridges now retain both riders through the native countdown:** the live trigger byte suppresses the split solid pass while `loc_3890C` returns without the ordinary slope helper; countdown expiry then clears every riding player's standing state and sets them airborne (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:75592-75605,75743-75795`).
- **HCZ2 cutscene Knuckles now observes its native initialization rectangle:** `Check_CameraInRange` defers setup until the camera enters `word_62150`, then self-patches the operation pointer past the check; the controller no longer initializes early enough to pin the left boundary and suppress the spindash history-camera jerk (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:128908-128972,180428-180459,38364-38429`).
- **HCZ Jawz now consumes its post-camera offscreen-placeholder render state:** the retained `$20` placeholder visibility spans the two-pixel vertical camera step into `Render_Sprites`, then preserves the separate saved-pointer restore and setup dispatches, aligning vertically entering patrol movement and the exact-edge enemy bounce (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:180266-180298,183518-183570,36318-36365`).

- **HCZ Jawz now resolves attacks through native `$D7` special-property ownership:** `Touch_Special` accumulates P1/P2 collision-property values before Obj93 selects the final native player and runs `Check_PlayerAttack` / `EnemyDefeated`, so simultaneous overlap gives the kill bounce to P2 instead of whichever engine touch callback destroys the badnik first (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:21162-21194,179747-179865,183518-183570`).
- **HCZ hand launchers now retain `SolidObjectTop`'s relative fresh-landing snap:** Obj3A no longer applies the separate `PlatformObject_ChkYRange` absolute surface override after `sub_1E410`, preserving the native landing Y when Tails restores his standing radius in the same frame (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:41982-42068,65798-65827`).
- **HCZ spinning columns now preserve exact-right-edge side contact:** Obj68's `SolidObjectFull` path keeps `relX == d1*2` in the zero-distance collision window, restoring the native one-frame `Status_Push` contact (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:41394-41403,68148-68157`).
- **HCZ spinning columns now use their post-movement X as the continued-ride reference:** Obj68 passes its updated `x_pos` through `d4`, producing zero horizontal platform carry and preserving the rider position established by the capture routine (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:68132-68157,41016-41042,41642-41679`).
- **S3K tension bridges now reject exact-boundary first contacts:** their flat `sub_1E410` entry accepts only negative overlap from `-$10` through `-1`, keeping an exact-zero airborne contact detached until it enters the native landing band (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:75871-75946,41982-42068`).

- **HCZ snake blocks now use their post-movement X as the continued-ride reference:** Obj67 passes its updated `x_pos` through `d4` to `MvSonicOnPtfm`, producing zero horizontal platform carry while preserving the rider's own ground motion (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:50893-50910,41016-41042,41642-41679`).

- **feat(rewind): validate captured-reference closure throughout S2/S3K trace replay.** Every real level frame now checks that compact-captured object references still resolve through the strict rewind identity table, exposing lifecycle defects at their first frame instead of during a later rewind capture. The full level-trace sweep retained strict missing-identity failures while repairing the discovered MHZ1 Knuckles, ICZ capture-cloud, and MCZ rotating-platform lifetime/anchor bugs.
- **fix(rewind): preserve MCZ rotating-platform shared unload anchors.** Obj6A children keep their shifted live positions but now inherit the parent's pre-shift `objoff_32/30` anchor, so their independent SST execution cannot drop one child early and leave a stale captured reference. The authoritative parent child list retains a deferred inverse owner link for defensive detach and post-rewind relinking (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:54184-54213,54278-54280,54303-54305`).
- **fix(rewind): classify AIZ intro glow spawn-derived state.** The glow child's immutable animation variant and plane offsets are now explicitly identified as derivatives of captured spawn subtype; construction rejects a disagreeing selector argument, and focused rewind coverage proves both child variants reconstruct their ROM-authored offsets.
- **fix(rewind): detach unloaded ICZ capture clouds from their freezer.** When a capture cloud completes its off-phase self-delete, its live freezer parent no longer retains an unregistered object reference that breaks rewind reference-closure validation.
- **fix(rewind): detach unloaded MHZ1 cutscene Knuckles actors from their button.** When the offscreen actor left the dynamic object set, its live parent button no longer retained an unregistered object reference that crashed rewind capture.
- **fix(rewind): detach unloaded Turbo Spiker shells from their parent object.** A launched shell that left the dynamic object set could remain referenced by its live parent, causing rewind capture to fail because the removed child no longer had a registered object identity.
- **fix(tails): correct S3K swimming presentation and idle vertical motion.** Swimming animations `$25-$28` now suppress the separate Obj05 flying-tail overlay because their body mappings already include Tails' tails, and active swimming bypasses the ordinary airborne underwater `-$28` adjustment so no-input motion uses only the ROM's `+$08` flight gravity.
- **fix(tails): preserve the ROM-selected body animation during manual flight and swimming.** `Tails_Set_Flying_Animation` now retains its native `$20-$28` animation byte through the generic airborne animation pass, matching the already-correct CPU recovery presentation instead of being overwritten by Tails' ordinary air/walk sprite.
- **feat(tails): restore source-owned flight, swimming, and carry behavior across donated presentations.** The donor-capability matrix now follows the source game—S3K enables Tails flight/swim while S2 disables them even when using the S3K presentation—and the playable controller reproduces ROM flight exhaustion, re-flight, underwater swim, animation, art, and audio cadence. Carry remains main-player-only, while CPU/manual-flight control, CNZ carry triggers, MGZ scripted handoffs, rewind state, and cross-game animation/audio translation preserve their existing behavior.
- **fix(s2ss): draw special-stage player depth-priority buckets in the correct direction.** `DisplaySprite` queues each object's `priority(a0)` into an ascending `Object_Display_Lists` index and `BuildSprites` drains those lists low-index first, so a *lower* priority value always reaches `Sprite_Table` first and therefore occludes (wins over) higher-value same-tile-priority sprites added later. The special-stage player renderer's shadow and body passes drew buckets ascending (lowest value first, highest drawn last/on top) — backwards from that rule, and from the descending-bucket convention the normal-level renderer already uses for the same reason. Both passes now draw the highest depth-priority bucket first and the lowest last, so the swap-driven front/behind relationship between Sonic and Tails now matches ROM throughout a swap instead of only in the default (unswapped) pose (`docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:30358-30363,30523-30636`).
- **fix(s2ss): restore Sonic-over-Tails render priority in the special stage.** Sonic's special-stage object (`MainCharacter`) is always processed before Tails' (`Sidekick`), so his sprite always reaches `Sprite_Table` first each frame; same-priority VDP sprites earlier in the table occlude later ones. The renderer's player-ordering merge sort now breaks a tied depth-priority in favor of the main character instead of falling back to incidental insertion order, so Sonic stays visually in front of Tails exactly as ROM does (`docs/s2disasm/s2.constants.asm:1101-1103`, `docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:30523-30594,69505-69544`).
- **fix(rewind): restore Sonic 2 Masher movement deterministically after live rewind.** Masher's context-aware capture and restore paths now preserve its complete fixed-point motion state, including fractional subpixel phase, jump origin, and velocities, then synchronize the inherited position and velocity view so forced reconstruction resumes on the exact captured trajectory.
- **AIZ2's post-bombing forest now retains its Plane A columns across the native `$200` camera loop:** the foreground ring consumes the ROM-visible `Level_repeat_offset` and translates its world-coordinate reconciliation baseline instead of mistaking the `$46BC->$44C0` loop step for a rewind seek and re-seeding the sparse forest entrance every lap (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:105200-105253`).
- **Direct AIZ2 entry now initializes its native background deformation:** the title-card startup no longer mistakes a clear `Level_started_flag` for AIZ1's plane-intro phase, so level-select, save, and restart entry routes immediately use `AIZ2_BackgroundInit`'s half-speed vertical position and scattered horizontal parallax (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:102255,104990-105003`).
- **AIZ intro plane propeller and booster pieces render from their native plane art again:** the two SST-backed animated children retain the slot pressure required for trace parity, but their mapping frames now use `Map_AIZIntroPlane` / `ArtTile_AIZIntroPlane` instead of accidentally selecting the same frame numbers from the Chaos Emerald sheet (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:135741-135819`).
- **Runtime water enable state now mirrors mutable ROM `Water_flag`:** disabling water preserves loaded height, target, palette, and handler registers and is rewind-captured independently of the immutable level-water profile. AIZ2's battleship ShipRefresh pass now clears that flag when it allocates the ship, preventing post-boss players from entering the obsolete `$0618` water plane (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:104911-104934`).
- **AIZ's post-results camera, button, Knuckles, and drawbridge now retain ROM cadence:** the gradual max-X worker exposes its accumulated high word per entry, `Check_InMyRange` treats the cutscene-button table as lower-offset plus span, the replacement bridge inherits its already-settled layout-object state, Knuckles keeps his setup-only first dispatch, and the button/bridge handoff preserves both the authored SST ordering and the still-riding sidekick control path before clearing both riders (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:133916-133976,138282-138326,59614-59623,59764-59791`).
- **AIZ capsule/results control now follows native P1/P2 slot ordering:** the capsule defers its signed Ctrl-2 lock to the next owner entry, preserves the logical controller word while signed-locked, applies the results pose at its ROM eligibility boundary, and restores Tails control from the later results slot through rewind-captured state. Trace comparison retains the CPU-decision controller sample separately when that later capsule slot clears the live latch (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:166696-166703,181556-181570,181900-181918`).
- **AIZ end-boss collision and defeat handoff now preserve native object-pass boundaries:** the emerge callback defers restored collision until the following boss entry, while the defeated ship/explosion wait finishes before the independent `$7F` capsule handoff wait begins. This aligns the final rebound and post-boss capsule allocation without trace-frame exceptions (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:177558-177610,177944-177952`).
- **S3K seamless act handoffs now preserve fixed air-countdown slots:** the two native `Obj_AirCountdown` fixed SST owners and their RNG/timer state survive an adjacent same-zone act advance, while ordinary zone loads and non-adjacent act loads still reset them. AIZ1→AIZ2 therefore retains the ROM's persistent fixed-object cadence (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:22221-22224,27436-27439`).
- **AIZ Monkey Dude root arms now own their native random cadence:** the separately allocated arm-root routine keeps its full-screen activation gate, two setup passes, attack phases, and high-word `RNG_seed` timer/direction reads even though the engine retains its consolidated arm renderer. This restores every Monkey Dude random call observed before the AIZ end boss without coupling behavior to the trace route (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:183755-183913`).
- **S3K signpost sparkles now use the native global phase, random word, and Y offset:** `Obj_EndSignFall` tests `V_int_run_count & 3` instead of an allocation-local counter; every resulting sparkle advances `RNG_seed` once and starts at `(d0 & $1F)-$10` relative Y, preserving the random cadence carried into later badnik and boss decisions (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:176148-176153,176294-176300`).
- **AIZ flipping bridges now reserve their native multisprite child SST:** the consolidated bridge still renders all eight segments in one Java object, but it also performs the ROM's `AllocateObjectAfterCurrent` for the `loc_2AA78` draw owner. Later collapsing platforms and spilled rings therefore see the correct occupied slot (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:58872-59043`).
- **AIZ2's rising-water shake now owns its native 180-frame SST timer:** `DynamicWaterHeight_AIZ2` allocates the invisible `Obj_6E6E` countdown alongside `Screen_shake_flag`; the shared water profile can now request that slot-owning timer instead of tracking only the global countdown. This preserves the object-table pressure seen by later AIZ decorations and badnik children (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:8648-8713`).
- **AIZ's battleship `Scroll_lock` now preserves pending horizontal camera history:** the ship loop skips normal camera movement without clearing `H_scroll_frame_offset`, exactly as `DeformBgLayer` does while `Scroll_lock` is set. When the small craft releases the lock, the parked position-history delay resumes instead of following Sonic immediately (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:38288-38303,104892-104910,105200-105253,105572-105619`).
- **Negative ceiling probes now use each game's native collision-layout height:** S1/S2 retain their 2048-pixel lookup window, while S3K's default `Layout_row_index_mask=$7C` selects a 4096-pixel window. Above-top S3K probes no longer wrap into the wrong `$07xx` terrain row and manufacture a ceiling hit (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:19141-19163,20242-20282,102181-102204`).
- **S3K collapsing platforms now skip fresh contacts on their fragment-creation dispatch:** `ObjPlatformCollapse_CreateFragments` jumps directly to its sound tail instead of calling `SolidObjectTopSloped2`. Existing riders retain their standing bits across that skipped pass, but a second player cannot newly attach until the following `loc_205DE` dispatch resumes collision (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:44814-44864,45394-45442`).
- **Attracted rings now participate in every native player touch pass:** attraction motion retains its existing owner, while collection checks P1 and live sidekicks in ROM player-slot order. A ring crossing CPU Tails can therefore enter its sparkle routine immediately instead of waiting to overlap Sonic (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:18444-18531,20612-20640,35760-35837`).
- **S3K sidekick hurt recovery now restores collision radii after a status-only roll clear:** S3K `HurtCharacter` calls `Player_TouchFloor`, whose Tails branch unconditionally restores `default_x_radius/default_y_radius` before testing `Status_Roll`. The S3K movement profile now does the same when the rolling flag is already clear but rolling radii remain live, preventing CPU Tails from probing a floor with a stale 7x14 box while preserving S2's distinct `Hurt_Sidekick` behavior (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:21065-21093,24335-24369,29133-29170`).
- **AIZ still-sprite ride vines now release their SST chain at the native render boundary:** the moving `$90` vine observes the preceding fixed 320x224 `Render_Sprites` visibility bit, writes `$7FF0` once wholly off-screen, and lets the root's fixed `$280` coarse cull delete all children regardless of handle grabs. S3K's two-axis placement cursor likewise keeps its ROM `$280` X edge instead of widening allocation timing with the renderer (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:37545-37628,46198-46212,46336-46357`).
- **AIZ/LRZ rock debris now retains the parent SST slot:** breaking a rock converts its existing object entry into the first debris fragment and allocates only the remaining fragments after it, matching the ROM's in-place `a0` conversion instead of freeing a low slot beneath the debris set (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:44502-44578`).
- **Ordinary AIZ ride vines now reserve their native child SST entries:** the consolidated Java object retains its root slot while reserving the four link objects and final handle allocated by `AllocateObjectAfterCurrent`, preserving ROM object-table pressure during the vine's lifetime (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:46115-46142`).
- **AIZ's HCZ handoff now preserves the ROM camera sample:** when the falling player reaches the `StartNewLevel` threshold, the post-boss controller freezes the camera at the pre-physics airborne target before requesting the full zone transition, so the ordinary later camera pass cannot advance it from `$02B6` to `$02C2` (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:138318-138326,178210-178229`).
- **AIZ's post-boss sidekick lock now clears the late logical controller word:** the `loc_863C0` replacement preserves CPU movement generation, then clears the live `Ctrl_2_logical` latch from its later object slot while the positive lock is active; detailed CPU-step diagnostics retain the pre-clear sample (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:181346-181365`).
- **AIZ's boss-end draw bridge now preserves rider facing:** the consolidated bridge exposes the ROM parent's permanent status-bit-7 balance suppression, so `Sonic_Move` skips object-edge balancing instead of briefly turning Sonic toward the parent object's distant left edge (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:22450-22461,59490-59507`).
- **AIZ's end boss now enters hover on the raw-animation callback frame:** the revealed `$1B/$1C/$1D/0` sequence uses `Animate_RawNoSSTMultiDelay`'s actual five/six/seven/one-frame holds, while the first camera-minimum write remains invisible until the following camera pass and the skipped right-bound increment is restored when routine `$C` exits. This aligns the oscillator, repeated boss rebounds, and the full `$4880..$4980` arena expansion (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:138109-138150,138203-138229,177558-177610`).
- **AIZ's battleship object now waits for the foreground ShipRefresh pass:** `AIZ2SE_Normal` still arms auto-scroll immediately, but `Obj_AIZBattleship` is allocated only when the following `AIZ2SE_ShipRefresh` redraw completes. This removes a one-frame-early bomb impact and CPU-Tails hurt without delaying the first `$+4` special-event camera step (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:104872-104925,105257-105427`).
- **The AIZ2 battleship loop now separates its screen-event arm from its first special-event dispatch:** consuming `Events_fg_4` installs the ship-loop routine without immediately adding four pixels to camera X; the following `SpecialEvents` pass performs the first `$+4` step, matching the `AIZ2SE_Normal` to `AIZ2_DoShipLoop` handoff (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:104872-104910,105200-105253`).
- **Both AIZ collapsing-log bridge variants now reject exact-boundary top landings:** the normal and fire subtypes share `SolidObjectTop`'s unsigned `-$10..-$1` overlap window, so an airborne player whose bottom is exactly level with the surface remains airborne until genuine overlap on the following frame (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:59299-59306,59341-59348,42048-42068`).
- **AIZ's in-level Act 2 title handoff now follows the module-visible child phase:** the HUD reset and `Obj_TitleCardWait2` completion are scheduled from the four-phase title-child visibility boundary, while airborne `Change_Act2Sizes` workers defer their first fixed-point carry until the following camera pass. This keeps both level-select and complete-run title/reset/camera timing aligned without changing the title animation itself (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:62214-62279,178154-178225,2726-2789`).
- **AIZ's fire handoff now follows queued terrain, VBlank redraw, and module-DMA visibility:** decompressed AIZ2 collision tables become live while `AIZ1BGE_Finish` is still waiting, VBlank-only trace rows drain only the delayed plane redraw, and act reload waits for the first four-phase module-DMA boundary after the 64-tick minimum instead of one fixed route-wide delay (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:2726-2789,7884-7910,104664-104774,105049-105096`).
- **AIZ intro waves now preserve the ROM callback dispatch before releasing their SST slots:** `Animate_RawMultiDelay` command `$F4` installs `Go_Delete_Sprite`; deletion happens when that operation runs on the following object pass. The engine previously destroyed the wave inside the animation callback, leaving one low slot empty on every six-frame wave rotation (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:135820-135841,136013-136020,177558-177613`).
- **The two animated AIZ intro-plane pieces now consume their native SST slots:** `CreateChild1_Normal` creates the plane followed by the `$38,$04` and `$18,$18` child pieces, so the engine now registers all three as dynamic objects in slots 6–8 instead of keeping the latter two as slotless render helpers. Their animation variant and parent links are rewind-safe (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:135702-135819,136001-136012`).
- **The AIZ intro controller now occupies its ROM-authored fixed SST slot:** `SpawnLevelMainSprites` writes `Obj_AIZPlaneIntro` directly to `Dynamic_object_RAM+(object_size*2)`, absolute S3K slot 5, rather than calling `AllocateObject`. The engine now reserves that exact slot instead of taking the first free dynamic slot, preserving later object allocation order without a route or frame exception (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:8111-8126`; both AIZ traces record the parent in slot 5).
- **AIZ's temporary fire-transition floor now preserves the player's native fixed-point carry phase at the exact-surface boundary:** the split solid-contact bridge consumes 20 repeated zero-distance passes for a high `y_sub` phase and 21 for a low phase before exposing `SolidObjectTop`'s native first-landing placement. This replaces one global count that made two ROM-valid AIZ routes land on opposite sides of the correct frame (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:104777-104790,41642-41679,41793-42015`).
- **AIZ giant ride vines now obey the root object's unconditional ROM cull and release both ownership layers:** handle grab bytes no longer make the consolidated vine persistent, and unloading explicitly frees its distinct parent slot as well as the reserved child chain. This prevents an off-screen CPU-sidekick grab from retaining the vine root and shifting later star-post, badnik, and lost-ring allocations (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:46749-46831`).
- **AIZ continuous screen shake now preserves the ROM's two-register ScreenEvents phase:** the foreground event applies the offset prepared by the preceding background event, while `ShakeScreen_Setup` prepares the following offset from the ROM-visible `Level_frame_counter`. This prevents render visibility—and CPU Tails' off-screen watchdog—from observing the next shake sample one frame early (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:104183-104206,104870-104875,105132-105165,36345-36387`).
- **Ground edge-balance facing now consumes the ROM-latched probe angles at the pre-movement decision point:** `Player_AnglePos` refreshes `Primary_Angle`/`Secondary_Angle`, but Sonic/Tails copy those bytes to `next_tilt`/`tilt` only after their movement dispatch. The engine now retains those latches and reuses the balance result computed before movement instead of rescanning after `AnglePos`, preventing a freshly landed Tails from turning toward an edge one frame early (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:26215-26244,27796-27859`; S2 uses the same player-tail copy ordering).
- **AIZ Act 2 boundary resizing now releases the defeated miniboss slot at the native handoff:** `Obj_EndSignControlDoStart` allocates independent max-X/max-Y gradual workers and deletes the former boss object, allowing later placement objects and hurt-spill rings to reuse the low slot while camera resizing continues. The engine previously kept the persistent miniboss alive as the resize proxy, shifting every later `AllocateObject` result and changing a lost ring's floor-bounce phase (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:180415-180419,180575-180609,178154-178169,178210-178225`).
- **AIZ falling logs now reject exact-boundary top landings:** their `SolidObjectTop` profile accepts only negative overlap from -16 through -1, matching the routine’s unsigned `cmpi.w #-$10,d0 / blo` gate. A zero-distance airborne contact now remains airborne instead of spuriously attaching to the newly fallen log (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:59965-60003,42048-42068`).
- **AIZ collapsing log bridges now accept native post-movement top landings:** both normal and fire paths pass the current player position directly to `SolidObjectTop`; the normal bridge no longer adds a previous-frame-in-band requirement that rejected fast downward overlaps. Collapse arming still consumes the resulting standing bit on the following bridge dispatch (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:59269-59348,41793-42068`).
- **AIZ Caterkiller Jr children now preserve native after-current allocation and setup timing:** `CreateChild3_NormalRepeated` keeps all six body segments after the attackable head in object/touch order, while each folded Java child constructor retains the routine-0 setup-only dispatch before its routine-2 wait countdown. Sonic can therefore destroy the head before later HURT segments are scanned without shifting earlier CPU Tails contacts (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:176996-177027,183317-183515`).
- **S3K low-speed ducking now preserves the native pre-movement edge-balance decision:** the existing `Sonic_Move`/`Tails_Move` look gate captures the balance state and facing before `SpeedToPos` and `Player_AnglePos`; the later moving-crouch bridge consumes that decision instead of probing the player's already-advanced position. This prevents CPU Tails from choosing the opposite lip one frame late while holding Down (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:27796-27861`).
- **AIZ/LRZ rock breaks now preserve native multi-player support release and S3K CPU-interact identity:** the intact rock exposes its `$0001` routine-pointer high word to `Tails_CPU_interact`, and every player whose standing bit was set by the shared `SolidObjectFull` pass is ejected when either player breaks the rock. This mirrors `sub_1FF1E` instead of releasing only the breaker (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:44180-44303,26816-26843`).
- **S3K title-card exit now consumes native render bounds and parent/child ordering:** each child slides until its prior `Render_Sprites` pass marks the authored width/height wholly off-screen, deletes on the following object dispatch, and lets the parent wait observe the empty child count one pass later. AIZ's Act 2 size proxy now starts on that parent-observation frame, with its +2 vertical-boundary compensation limited to the creation tick before generic easing can see the new target (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:62244-62399,36345-36387,178210-178225`).
- **AIZ's in-level Act 2 title card now clears the HUD state at the native wait boundary:** the results object carries its reset request into the title-card slide-in, and the manager publishes the fresh `LevelGamestate` when the object-owned wait reaches the display position. This replaces a four-display-tick heuristic that left `Ring_count` visible 26 frames too long (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:62708-62720,62214-62235`).
- **AIZ miniboss body hurt checks now read the live refreshed child position:** `loc_686E8` updates the body from its parent immediately before `Child_DrawTouch_Sprite2` publishes the object-RAM pointer. The engine now consumes that live position on the following player slot, restoring the one-pixel boundary contact that sends CPU Tails into native hurt state (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:136888-136921,20656-20710`).
- **CPU Tails now participates in AIZ miniboss parent touch response:** the parent no longer uses a main-player-only actor profile, allowing Tails' attacking contact to follow native `Touch_Enemy` boss handling—negating `x_vel`, `y_vel`, and `ground_vel` and consuming a boss hit (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:20875-20938`).
- **AIZ miniboss touch ordering now follows its native child chain and collision-list pointer:** `CreateChild1_Normal` components and breath flames allocate after the parent rather than in the lowest free slot, keeping the attackable boss ahead of its HURT body. The parent also reads its live post-motion object-RAM position through the prior `Collision_response_list` pointer, aligning boss-hit velocity reversal without changing other enemy timing (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:137222-137271,137396-137422,176919-176950,20656-20710`).
- **S3K lost-ring floor probes now use the complete native cadence inputs:** Obj37 adds the live `Process_Sprites` `d7` countdown across all 110 `Object_RAM` slots, rather than stopping at the engine-managed dynamic window, and `RingRules` carries S3K's four-count native VBlank baseline relative to the gameplay-scoped object clock. S1/S2 retain a zero baseline (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:35616-35637,35965-35980`).
- **S3K collapsing-platform fragments now consume the preceding render pass's on-screen bit before falling:** `loc_20620` deletes an off-screen fragment before `MoveSprite`, while the delay routine keeps drawing until it hands off. Fragment visibility is latched in the engine's post-camera render-state phase with the inherited platform width/height, replacing the shared post-movement 128-pixel lifetime margin that kept stale fragment slots alive (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:44879-44883,45308-45431,36345-36387`).
- **S3K hurt spills now reserve the complete Obj37 after-current slot chain at the player-slot instant:** the deferred materialization bridge previously reserved only the owner ring, allowing later object slots to delete before the other 31 rings were allocated on the next frame. The reservation now snapshots every `AllocateObjectAfterCurrent` result immediately while keeping object creation deferred, so newly-freed holes cannot shift the spill's native slot phases (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:21065-21088,35490-35591,37899-37934`).
- **S3K trace replay now samples split-row camera diagnostics at their VBlank-visible instant:** when a full gameplay row is immediately followed by an unchanged VBlank-only row with the same gameplay counter, S3K comparison borrows only that following row's camera coordinates. Gameplay state and ring count remain strict to the current row, so the sampling correction cannot hide collection-timing failures.
- **AIZ Bloominator now follows native dormant, animation, child-slot, and touch-list timing:** Obj_WaitOffscreen keeps collision disabled through its placeholder and init dispatches, the idle gate consumes full render bounds, `Animate_RawMultiDelay` fires when script offsets `6/$E` are loaded, and `CreateChild2_Complex` allocates the projectile after the parent so its post-movement hurt region is visible later in the same object pass (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:176955-176981,180266-180298,182533-182650`).
- **AIZ Caterkiller Jr now remains inert until its full Obj_WaitOffscreen placeholder is visible:** the parked object uses the ROM's `$20`-pixel X/Y render bounds rather than a horizontal-only check, and exposes zero collision flags until `SetUp_ObjAttributes` has effectively run. This prevents an offscreen enemy slot from hurting CPU Tails while the camera is still vertically above it (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:180266-180298,183317-183337`).
- **S3K CPU Tails now preserves terrain-owned underwater push state across released object-slot bookkeeping:** the sidekick controller already distinguished a fresh `CalcRoomInFront` wall push from stale solid-object residue before the CPU read, but its post-read clear still erased the native bit solely because an old `interact` slot was gone. Terrain provenance now owns both decisions, so `loc_13DD0` keeps bypassing follow nudges until gameplay actually clears `Status_Push` (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:26702-26705,27974-28018`).
- **Seamless level reloads now preserve the ROM's post-event oscillator tick:** S3K applies AIZ's act reload from `ScreenEvents`, then returns to the remainder of `LevelLoop`, where `OscillateNumDo` still advances before rendering. The engine's pending-transition path skips that remainder, so its existing reload-frame counter bridge now advances the global oscillator as well. This restores AIZ2 floating-platform phase without trace hydration or a zone/frame exception (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:7884-7910,104722-104774`).
- **AIZ Rhinobot now activates through Obj_WaitOffscreen's `$20` placeholder bounds and targets the nearest native player:** its center-only visibility gate held patrol dormant after ROM had begun moving, leaving the badnik ten pixels too far right when Sonic should hit it; the restored patrol/charge position also restores `Touch_Enemy`'s upward `y_vel += $100` bounce. Charge detection now mirrors `Find_SonicTails` by choosing the horizontally-nearest of native P1/P2 before applying range and facing tests (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:178243-178277,180266-180298,182367-182553`).
- **S3K vertical and diagonal springs now clear the player's `jumping` byte on launch:** up, down, and both diagonal trigger tails overwrite velocity and then clear `jumping`; without that write, releasing a jump button after landing on a spring incorrectly ran the variable jump-height cap against the spring's object-owned velocity (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:47714-47726,48139-48144,48213-48217,48304-48308`).
- **S3K CPU Tails now preserves a live SolidObject-owned push bit while rolling:** the stale-push filter previously discarded every grounded `Status_Push+Status_Roll` sample with nonzero inertia, even when the shared SolidObject controller still held the object's native per-player pushing latch. That made Tails run FollowRight at AIZ2's rock instead of taking `loc_13DD0`'s literal current-push bypass. Object push ownership is now queryable, so live solid and terrain-wall sources survive while unowned stale residue (including the existing ICZ segment-column case) still falls through (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:26702-26705,43916-43935`).
- **S3K Cork Floor roll-break launches now preserve the player's native `y_pos`:** the solid-contact bridge can restore standing dimensions before Obj2F changes the player back to rolling radii/status; applying that visual-height change used to move the engine player's centre upward by five pixels even though ROM `sub_2A58E` never writes `y_pos`. The launch now restores the original centre coordinate with subpixels intact after changing dimensions (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:58493-58554`).
- **Moving S3K spikes now gate `SolidObjectFull` with the prior render position:** movement still occurs before the solid helper, but the on-screen bit consumed by `loc_1DF88` comes from the preceding `Render_Sprites` pass, preventing a spike entering the viewport from becoming solid one frame early (`docs/skdisasm/sonic3k.asm:41390-41392,49011-49039,49102-49131`).
